On the other hand, Pyowol’s face was hardened beyond words. Instinctively, he sensed that something big had happened.
thud!
Finally, the boat with the Unma Riverboat tied to its tail docked at the dock.
People waiting at the dock approached the captain and crew.
“What is it?”
“Why did you bring the Unmado steel wire?”
The captain shook his head in response to people’s questions.
“See for yourself.”
“what?”
“You will know when you see it for yourself.”
At the words of the captain, people hurriedly climbed onto the Unma River.
“Big!”
“what?”
Those who unknowingly climbed the Unma Riverboat covered their mouths with their hands.
The deck of the Unmado riverboat was lined with half-burnt bodies. At the sight of the terrifying corpses, those with weak stomachs began to vomit.
“What kind of people…”
“The captain of this ship is definitely Hwangcheol-hyung. That older brother will be retiring in a few days…”
“Hehehehe!”
Weeping voices were heard from everywhere.
People couldn’t even dare to look inside the ship anymore at such a gruesome sight.
Pyowol climbed onto the deck and looked around slowly.
‘Like a cow in a slaughterhouse, he was slaughtered while being trapped in a boat.’
He checked the condition of the bodies.
Each wound was deep and fatal.
He wasn’t aiming for urine or bloodletting with an elaborate herbivore diet. It was ignorantly strong internal air or power.
It was a phenomenon that appeared among those who had mastered martial arts.
The more I looked, the more familiar the scars were.
I had seen this kind of wound somewhere before.
Pyowol carefully inspected all the wounds of the dead on the deck.
“Did you find out anything?”
Hong Yu-shin came to Pyo-wol’s side.
Pyowol shook his head and looked at the next corpse.
“Mmm!”
“Why is that?”
Hong Yu-shin looked at Pyo-wol with a puzzled expression.
“This person is like a guru of non-partisans.”
“yes?”
“This is the face I saw when I went to the shaman group before.”
The person Pyo-wol pointed to was Yun-gwang, the third generation disciple of the shaman faction.
Yoon Kwang was dying with his mouth wide open and a painful expression on his face. Not far from Yoon-gwang, Han-gwang had stopped breathing.
“Why are you a disciple of a non-partisan faction?”
Hong Yu-shin frowned.
Currently, the shaman faction was half sealed.
Although it was not officially declared, the door was locked and refrained from external activities.
“If this happens, the shamans will be given a reason to intervene in the Great War.”
A disciple of Jaffa died at Lake Poyang in the midst of the Great War between Gangs and Lakes.
As a non-partisan, it was more strange to stay still.
It wasn’t just the non-partisan disciple who died.
A number of dead bodies were also found with swords or swords in their hands.
I don’t know which faction these warriors belong to, but those who are related to them won’t stand still.
“A storm will blow over Lake Poyang.”
Hong Yushin shook his head.
It was as if he could see Lake Poyang, which had already turned into a sea of blood.
Thanks to Pyo-wol’s unified affairs in the area, the Gang-ho War seemed to fall into a lull for a while, but it was almost certain that it would flare up again because of today’s incident.
In addition, public sentiment will become even more brutal.
Most of the passengers on the Unma Dogangseon were people who had nothing to do with Gangho.
It was an unwritten rule of the Gangho that no matter how fiercely the fighters fought, they did not harm the civilians.
History has shown that the Munpa, who lost public sentiment, could not dominate the world no matter how strong they were.
Because of that, Gangho’s literary faction tried hard not to lose public sentiment.
It was the same for the Geumcheonhoe and Eunryeonhoe, but what happened today was like adding fuel to the angry public.
“Everyone get off the boat.”
“Everybody get off.”
The warriors of the Union Association who came running late forced the people on board to disembark.
A look of bewilderment was evident on their faces.
Only the warriors were capable of committing such atrocities.
It was not something the union association did, but it was clear that they would be tied together and criticized.
I had to stop the spread of rumors somehow.
At least until we figure out who did this. However, it was after many people had already witnessed the horrors of the Unmado River Ship.
It was impossible to keep everyone in the dock at bay.
“What kind of people did this?”
The face of the union leader’s face turned white. And Pyowol was watching him.
＊＊＊
The massacre of the privately operated Unma Riverboat near Poyang Lake was quickly known throughout the river.
Because it was such a shocking event.
All the unmanned soldiers on the Unma Dogangseon died with horrendous wounds, and the passengers were also devastated.
At least the male passengers died cleanly, but the bodies of the female passengers bore clear signs of coercion.
Witnesses were speechless at the sight of everyone from a young girl to a middle-aged woman being slaughtered.
A series of incidents infuriated people.
Even if it wasn’t, he wasn’t friendly to the unmanned people, but his anger exploded due to this incident.
Ordinary people had only one way to oppose the warriors or gangho clans.
It was just not cooperating with them.
No matter how powerful the munpa was, without the cooperation of the residents living nearby, the eyes and ears were blocked.
For that reason, the Daemun factions took special care of the cities where they had influence. It has been managed for hundreds of years to make it favorable to them. However, the massacre of the Unma Dogangseon at Poyang Lake was enough to demolish the tower that had been built over hundreds of years.
In particular, the closer the area to Poyang Lake, the more severe the public sentiment was.
As a result, many munpa took an emergency.
The fire also fell on the feet of the Geumcheonhoe and Eunryeonhoe.
The two forces blamed each other and said that the cause of all this was the other.
Kang-ho fell into deep confusion.
One of the munpa who fell into such confusion was the non-partisan faction.
All the leaders were gathered in the shaman faction’s Jaso Palace.
Jinin Cheongjin, a long-time scholar, Jinin Gonjin, Jinang, Jinin Sangjin, who is called the shaman’s first sword, and other elders gathered together with serious expressions on their faces.
Gongjin Jinin, who had been silent until now, opened his mouth.
“It is said that Taewon’s body has been found.”
“Mmm!”
“In the end…”
The elders let out a sigh and closed their eyes.
The bodies of Yoon-gwang and Han-gwang were found on the Unma Riverboat. But for some reason, Taewon’s body was nowhere to be seen, so he had a glimmer of hope that he might be alive.
Gongjin Jinin continued.
“It is said that a secular disciple of the main sect found it while searching for the Yangtze River, which suffered a cataclysm. However, the condition of the body is said to be very gruesome.”
“How is it?”
“It is said that his head is crushed and it is difficult to recognize his true form.”
“It can’t be….”
“What kind of people did this kind of wrathful thing?”
The elders shouted indignantly.
Taewon belonged to the lower ranks among the disciples of Lee Dae, but was loved by the elders for his calm personality and outstanding talent.
Because of his calm nature and excellent judgment of the situation, he was entrusted with the important task of grasping the situation of the river ahead of the other disciples.
The elders had no doubt that Taewon would do an excellent job. But unexpectedly, the sad news came.
Tae-won, Yoon-gwang, and Han-gwang, who were sent to Lake Poyang by the shaman faction, were all killed.
bang!
Sangjin Jinin hit the desk and jumped up.
“Long sentence death penalty! This is undoubtedly a challenge to the nonpartisans. please send me down I will find those who made Taewon and the children like that and make sure they pay for their sins.”
“Sangjin!”
“If we go on like this, the people of the world will look down on us. No matter how much the head faction is in the middle of a temporary siege, the face of the head faction will fall to the floor if this task is overlooked.”
“You’ll get attention when you go. If we do something wrong, the battle between the strong and the strong might further expand.”
Jinjin’s face was full of worry.
Although they have fallen away from people’s attention a little, shamans are still strong.
When Sangjin Jinin, a symbol of non-party force, moved, both Geumcheonhoe and Eunryeonhoe could misunderstand that the shaman faction was trying to intervene in the Gangho War.
If done wrong, the shaman faction could get caught up in a real gang-ho war.
Cheongjin Jinin wanted to prevent such a situation.
Sangjin Jinin protested.
“Are you going to stay like this? Three of the children of the main faction died? We must find out who the beast is and punish them.”
“Let’s do this. They belong to the main faction, but the people send out those they do not know.”
Chongjin Jinin came up with an answer after much thought.
“Is there such a person in the main sect?”
“Could it be a long sentence?”
“ah!”
The elders recalled someone and exclaimed.
Chongjin Jinin said with a smile on his lips.
“Yes, let the child go.”
“But doesn’t he catch and teach the Ilgeom Sasuk?”
“I received a call from my teacher a while ago. He said he taught everything to teach.”
“If so…”
The elders looked at each other.
It seemed that everyone was thinking the same thing.
‘It’s a graveyard.’
Everyone except Chongjin Jinin thought so.

chapters.title: Chapter 543
chapters.content:
Episode 543
The aftermath of the massacre of Unma Dogangseon was great.
It was to the point where the Geumcheonhoe and Eunryeonhoe declared that they would stop fighting for a while and investigate the truth.
Thanks to that, peace came to Poyang Lake, albeit temporarily. However, public sentiment, which had fallen into abyss, was still vicious.
People treated unmanned people as non-existent people, and some inns did not accept unmanned people at all. To that extent, hatred for the unmanned was rampant in the streets.
Of course, he did not openly oppose the unmanned people, but he showed his hostility towards the unmanned people through small rebellion.
The guest cup where Pyowol stayed was the same.
The owner of the inn made the excuse that the room was full and did not accept any more attendants.
As the owner of the inn, he had to take a pretty big loss, but he didn’t seem to have any regrets about his decision.
Fortunately, the owner of the inn did not show hostility to Pyo-wol.
It was because Haomen’s Hong Yuxin guaranteed it.
Gaekjan was one of the places connected to Haomen.
Because he had a long-standing relationship with Hao-wen, he could not refuse Hong Yu-shin’s request.
Thanks to this, Pyo-wol was able to stay comfortably in the inn.
Since the number of guests in the guesthouse has decreased, a lot has been solved in terms of noise.
Pyo-wol sat in a window seat and looked at Poyang Lake.
After the massacre of the Unma Dogangseon, the number of boats on Lake Poyang has definitely decreased.
It was almost invisible except for the fishing boats that had no choice but to come out for fishing.
“Huruk!”
Pyowol brought the teacup to his mouth and drank little by little.
After eating, my mouth felt refreshed.
It was then.
Squeak!
The door to the inn opened and someone came in.
He was a handsome man with his hair tied tightly.
In the hand of a man in his late twenties with a lively expression and a fresh smile, he held a sword that bent in a gentle curve.
The owner of the inn stopped the man in front of him and said.
“Unmanned people are not allowed in our inn. I’m sorry, but please go to another inn.”
“I didn’t come here to stay in an inn. I’ll just talk for a while.”
“But…”
“It will take a while. Nothing to worry about will happen.”
The man calmed the innkeeper and came inside.
The owner of the inn looked at the man’s back, not thinking about what to do.
After looking around the inside of the inn for a while, the man walked straight to Pyowol’s seat.
widely!
He sat across from him without permission from the moon.
“Long time no see.”
Hearing the man’s voice, Pyowol turned and looked at him.
“Lee Geomhan?”
“Nice to meet you!”
The man looking at Pyowol with a fresh smile was Gwangmumun’s Somunju and Jang Moo-geuk’s lifelong adversary Lee Geom-han.
At his appearance, Pyo-wol made an expression of surprise.
As such, the appearance of Lee Geom-han was unexpected.
“Didn’t you leave Poyang Lake?”
“I was going to, but I changed my mind.”
Squeeze!
Lee Geom-han naturally picked up the teapot placed in front of Pyowol and poured it into an empty cup.
Pyo-wol looked at Lee Geom-han without a word.
Lee Geom-han grinned and lifted the teacup.
“Sorry! It’s because I’m thirsty.”
Even though Pyo-wol was staring at him, Lee Geom-han casually drank the tea.
It was as if he had known Pyowol for a long time.
widely!
Finally, after drinking all the tea, Lee Geom-han put the cup down on the table. And he opened his mouth.
“I just want to say I’m sorry.”
“What are you sorry about?”
“The way Searle and her followers attacked your people at will. Their behavior was very rude. She may have done it for me, but I never wanted that.”
“Why are you apologizing for that?”
“Since it was my woman’s fault, I thought it was right for me to apologize. I hope you will accept my apology.”
Lee Geom-han’s attitude was very polite. It was bold nonetheless.
Pyo-wol thought that such an appearance suited the person named Lee Geom-han very well.
“I accept it. But you don’t seem to have come here simply to apologize?”
“You’re also quick-witted.”
Lee Geomhan nodded as if he knew that.
“what’s the matter?”
“I have come to inform you.”
“Notice?”
“From now on, I’m going to take over the federation.”
“Why are you notifying me of that?”
“Because there are many acquaintances of you in the union association.”
“So you’re trying to prevent me from intervening by giving you advance notice.”
“Exactly. As expected, it’s good that you don’t have to explain every word because you’re smart.”
“Why are you trying to get your hands on the federation now? I’ve been watching you all this time.”
“I’m saying this because I’ve watched it enough.”
Squeeze!
Lee Geom-han, perhaps thirsty, poured tea into the cup again.
Pyowol watched his actions without saying a word.
Lee Geom-han, who moistened his mouth with tea, spoke again.
“Answer me honestly. Do you think you can beat the Golden Reunion with all your strength?”
“…”
“Can’t you answer? I tried not to intervene if I could, but I will never be able to defeat Geumcheonhoe in the same way as now. More than anything else, Hoeju’s ability is too much.”
“You mean Dragon?”
The current owner of Eunryeonhoe was Sopaeryong Yonghasang, the owner of small grains in Yongcheongok.
Yong Ha-sang had a very warlike disposition.
Rather than making a plan and proceeding step by step, he had more improvised troops moving according to the situation at the time.
Because of that, the damage to the Union Association was growing exponentially.
Namgungwol and Juseolpung stepped forward to put the brakes on Yong Ha-sang’s arbitrariness, but it was not enough.
“If we leave him alone, the union association will collapse sooner or later.”
“Do you think it will be different if you become a Hoeju?”
“It will be different.”
“how?”
“You’ll know when you see it.”
Lee Geom-han answered with a confident expression.
“hmm!”
“Does it look terrifying?”
“It’s the word I hate the most. You will find out if you wait.”
“is it? Still, I can’t help it. Because I haven’t shown you anything yet.”
“I wish you good luck.”
“I’ll take that as a sign of not interfering.”
“Think whatever you want.”
“I know you’ll say no, but I want to ask you one last question.”
“I refuse in advance.”
“You know what I’m going to say?”
“It’s obvious. You’re probably asking me to be with you or help you.”
“As expected…”
Lee Geom-han couldn’t hide his admiration at Pyo-wol’s nonchalant reply.
It seemed like he was just spitting it out casually, but there was a bone hidden in Pyowol’s words. He also knew exactly who he was.
There weren’t that many in Gangho who had such good eyesight and quick brain rotation. So I felt more regretful.
It was because it wouldn’t be that difficult to get through the troubled times if only Pyo-wol was with him.
However, Lee Geom-han completely discarded the lingering feelings.
In the first place, Pyo-wol was not a person who matched himself. And he wasn’t the one to be under others.
It was clear that even if I had him under my command, I would not be able to use it properly.
Above all, they already had experience in clashes.
Back then, he thought he had the advantage, but now he didn’t know what would happen if they clashed.
I still haven’t turned Pyowol into an enemy. So he came directly.
To hear a word from Pyowol that he would not intervene.
Lee Geom-han threw away his last lingering feelings and stood up.
“I’ll just go and see. See you later.”
Lee Geom-han took a fist and walked out of the inn.
He felt Pyowol’s cold gaze on the back of his head, but Lee Geomhan did not look back.
When I came out, I saw Namgung Seol and Seolhwa Swordsman soldiers waiting.
The Seolhwa Swordsman was ready to jump into the inn at any moment.
Lee Geom-han looked at Seolhwa Swordsman with cold eyes.
He was well aware of the fact that they followed his lover, Namgungseol, but he only looked pitiful in his eyes.
Lee Geom-han’s gaze turned to Namgung Seol. Then, Namgungseol spoke in a low voice.
“Did you meet him?”
“hmm!”
“What about the story?”
“Good.”
“Is he still inside?”
“What are you thinking?”
“He is too dangerous.”
“so?”
“We have to get rid of it right now.”
In Namgungseol’s eyes, there was a deep life.
Lee Geomhan sighed.
“phew! We barely negotiated, so now we can attack?”
“He was all over the place.”
“so?”
“Are you asking because you don’t know? All of Salmun’s assassins obey his orders. Have you thought about how big of a threat that could be?”
“I know.”
“Black man!”
Namgungseol raised his voice. However, there was no change in Lee Geum-han’s expression.
he said calmly.
“You have already failed once.”
“It was different then and now. He’s alone now. There are enough possibilities. If you don’t want to help, back off. I won’t put any pressure on your prestige.”
“It’s not like that.”
“sure?”
“It means it will fail again.”
“Because it’s different from back then.”
“Nothing different. If you go inside now, you will all die.”
“Black man!”
“He is not the man he used to be. Now I can’t be sure I’ll be able to subdue him. So I negotiated with him. I don’t know?”
“You mean… that much?”
Namgungseol looked at Lee Geomhan with an expression of disbelief.
Lee Geomhan nodded with a firm expression.
“I saw it with my own eyes.”
“How could that be…”
“Three days of bereavement are remarkable. Pyowol is such an existence. Don’t bring your anger on yourself by hastily touching it.”
“Mmm!”
Namgungseol unknowingly let out a quiet voice. It was such a big shock.
She had never seen Lee Geom-han so highly regard his opponent. Even Zhang Wu-geuk, who everyone said was his opponent of a lifetime, was not given such a generous evaluation.
“So you’re going to leave him alone? You’ll definitely come back someday, right?”
“That’s something to think about when you go there. What we need to worry about now is taking over the union association.”
“Are you determined?”
Suddenly, Namgungseol’s eyes sparkled.
I had told Geomhan Lee countless times that I had to obtain the Unryeonhoe. But each time, Lee Geom-han replied that it was not the time yet. For the first time, he agreed with her opinion.
“Now we must begin.”
“What are you going to do? How about I go ahead and lay the plate?”
“no! You don’t have to.”
“But…”
“It’s only going to backfire if you overdo it with this kind of thing. Better to break through head-on.”
“Breaking through the front? Are you serious?”
“When did you see me lie? I’m serious.”
“Mmm!”
“Do you trust me?”
“sure.”
“Then trust me and follow me until the end. I’ll show you. my real strength.”
“all right.”
Namgungseol nodded.
The man who does not move easily, but once he does, causes storms and thunderbolts.
Falling in love with him, she became his woman and decided to live for him.
There was only one thing she could do at this moment when the storm named Lee Geom-han was about to start moving again.
just quietly follow him.
The rest will be taken care of by Lee Geum-han.

chapters.title: Chapter 544
chapters.content:
Episode 544
Pyo-wol looked at the door where Lee Geom-han left.
The voices of Lee Geom-han and Namgung-seol were heard for a moment, and then disappeared. In addition, the signs of the soldiers who were surrounding the guesthouse disappeared.
“Good.”
Pyowol mumbled in a low voice and stood up from his seat.
Namgungseol and Seolhwa Sword were not that scary.
The problem was Lee Geum-han.
Lee Geom-han’s individual strength was also formidable, but if Namgung Seol and Seolhwa Sword Corps joined together, Pyowol could not be sure of a victory.
I felt fortunate that that did not happen.
It was best to avoid troublesome things.
Even if it wasn’t Lee Geom-han, Pyo-wol wasn’t the only one to worry about. Among them, the ones that irritated him the most were those who massacred Unma Dogangseon.
The traces left on the Unmado River Line were somehow familiar to the eye. so i liked it
For the past few days, Pyowol tried to find those who raided Unma Dogangseon through Hong Yushin. However, even after mobilizing Hao Mun, he could not find the beast.
All the clans that owned large ships were subject to investigation.
Based on the information Hao Mun had, Hong Yu-shin investigated the clans that owned the ship. However, there was no sign that any munpa had moved the ship at the time the Unmado River Ship was attacked.
In the end, it could be seen that someone other than the existing forces moved the ship.
‘Even those with powers strong enough to annihilate all unmanned soldiers, including the disciples of the shaman faction.’
He was a non-partisan who temporarily chose Bongmun. It was clear that such a non-partisan faction would possess strong armed force if it was a military man secretly sent out. Such warriors were brutally hacked to death.
Looking at the scars left on the body, it was clear that at least four warriors were attached to each soldier and worked together.
The joint operation of the unmanned soldiers was indeed meticulous.
The blood of a non-partisan soldier has been scattered like a rag.
Such scars could not have occurred if organic movements were not supported that did not interfere with each other’s movements.
The types of weapons also varied.
At first glance, it seems that one weapon was used, but in fact, a wide variety of weapons were mobilized.
‘From knives and axes to harpoons…’
These were tools mainly used by sailors.
There was a deep gorge between Pyowol’s forehead.
‘Is it a ghost fleet?’
Among the sailors he knew, the most savage and terrifying group was the Ghost Fleet.
The Ghost Fleet was a group under the command of Guryongsalmak, and it deserved a grudge against Pyowol.
‘If I did, did it move towards me?’
He needed to check if his guess was correct.
Pyowol quietly got up and came out.
The warriors of the Seolhwa Sword Corps, who had surrounded the outside of the inn, had already disappeared and were nowhere to be seen.
Pyo-wol spread light air and escaped Poyang Lake.
His destination was the site of the catastrophic disaster on the Yunma Riverboat in the lower reaches of the Yangtze River.
There was no trace left of the flowing river and the famous Yangtze River. Nevertheless, the reason why Pyowol runs to the place where Unmado Gangseon was disastrous is because all pursuits start from the starting point.
It didn’t matter if there were no traces left.
If you look at the place where the catastrophe occurred there, you will surely gain something.
Pyowol spread light air with all his might.
Shih!
Every time Pyowol hit the ground, it stretched forward at a terrifying speed.
The light technique of Pyowol, which he learned on his own, was very unique.
Not only was it fast, but it left almost no traces on the floor. Like a floating dandelion spore, it was as if a ghost was galloping about, as if it were radiant and swift like a hawk.
After running for half a day, Pyo-wol arrived at the place where the Unma Dogang ship was said to have been disastrous.
Pyo-wol stood by the river and looked at the middle of the Yangtze River.
There are over 300 pages from where he is standing to the place where the Unmado River Ship was disastrously destroyed.
No matter how great Pyowol’s light technique was, he couldn’t jump over three hundred chapters at once, and even if it was possible, he couldn’t stand in the middle of the river without a foothold.
Pyowol found a small boat while walking along the river.
The old fisherman’s boat was worn out as if it would sink into the water at any moment.
Pyowol bought the old boat for five hermits. With that money, you could buy three or four new ships.
Squeak! Squeak!
Pyo-wol rowed and arrived at the place where the Unmado river ship was disastrous.
After all, nothing was left of the river.
Pyowol stopped the boat on the spot and looked around.
The topography of the area came into view at a glance.
The Ghost Fleet was mainly active at sea.
That’s why the ship had to be big and strong.
The structure was inevitably different from that of ships operating on rivers.
In order to sail stably in high waves, it was advantageous to use a narrow bottom boat with a deep bottom.
On the other hand, boats operating on rivers had to go to shallow waters, so there were many flat-bottomed boats.
The place Pyo-wol paid attention to was the place where the water was so deep that a tipped ship could pass through it.
It was impossible to measure the depth without going directly into the river. However, it could be inferred by looking at the flow rate or topography.
Standing on top of a small boat, Pyo-wol looked for a place where the tipped ship could go.
‘For now, it won’t be upstream. There were more ships going upstream, so it must have been noticeable. It won’t be too far down the river either. It’s because the boat that brought the Unma Riverboat came up from the downstream side.’
The attention of the sailors was not normal.
They must have thought it strange that a ship that could only sail on the sea would go up and down the river.
There must have been a way to get to the Unmado river ship easily without being noticed by them.
‘I would have had to approach from a tributary, not the main stream of the Yangtze River.’
The Yangtze River never consisted of only one stream. Numerous tributaries and small rivers were intertwined like a spider’s web.
Awesome! Awesome!
Pyowol started rowing downstream.
Among the tributaries of the Yangtze River, it was necessary to find a river that was large and deep enough for the pointed line to pass through.
Not long after I started rowing, a small tributary appeared. However, the shallow depth of the water made it difficult to cross the tip line.
Pyowol dared to pass by.
Two more tributaries appeared while going halfway down the stream. However, like the first tributary, the depth of the water was shallow, so it seemed difficult for large ships to enter and exit.
It was when we had rowed past the third tributary like that for about a meal.
The moon’s eyes shone sharply.
This is because the topography where tributaries and main streams merge again appeared. However, the tributary that appeared this time was different from other places.
Even at a glance, the water seemed turbid and black was very deep. Also, the width was very wide, so it seemed that there was no problem for a large ship to move around.
Pyo-wol drove the boat to the tributary without the slightest hesitation.
The current in the tributary was very strong. Because of that, it was not easy to go back to the small boat Pyowol was on.
Pyowol gave up the ship.
After putting the boat on the nearby reed field, they spread light air and ran down the tributary. Pyowol, who had been running for a long time, stopped.
This is because the tributary branched into two branches.
left and right. All rivers were wide and deep, so it seemed easy to navigate large ships.
Pyowol had to make a decision. And his decision was left.
There was no particular reason.
The only direction his sixth sense was pointing was to the left.
Pyowol went up the tributary again for a long time.
The sun had already set and it was getting dark.
At that time, a jar-like terrain appeared.
On one side of the tributary surrounded by the gorge, there was space for a boat.
It was a naturally formed terrain like a marina.
Pyo-wol flew toward it without hesitation.
There were traces of many people staying in the marina-like terrain.
Whoever it was, it was clear that quite a few people had been here for a while.
At that time, Pyowol’s eyes saw a strange sight.
The large rock face at the bottom of the canyon is dented vertically and horizontally.
it was a letter
Pyowol approached the rock to examine the letters closely.
When I got near the rock, the letters were clearly visible.
[Bulgongjiji Cheonwonsu (不共之戴天怨讐) Pyowoljimyo (漂月之墓).] The
letters someone engraved on the sword or road rock were clearly pointing to Pyowol.
‘My tomb?’
Took!
At that moment, I felt a strange sensation near my ankle.
In an instant, an intense sense of crisis overtook Pyowol.
Pyowol flew back without thinking further.
It was then.
Kwak Kwa Kwak!
Suddenly, a huge explosion occurred around the rock where the letter was engraved.
A thunderbolt was buried around the rock, and the string cut off Pyowol’s ankle actuated the trigger.
Kwak Kwa Kwa Kwam!
Explosions occurred in series and even hit the naturally formed dock.
Pyowol gritted his teeth and threw himself.
The flames approached with great speed. If you lose your movement even for a moment, you will be consumed by the flames.
The problem wasn’t just the flames.
Cuckoo!
The huge gorge was collapsing, unable to overcome the impact of the thunderclap.
The sight of falling rocks filling the sky was terrifying.
Peony was no exception.
It was such a shocking sight that the feeling of fear, thought long ago gone, came back to life.
“Suck!”
Pyowol breathed in and accelerated.
His new model came out of the canyon in a long parabola like a meteor.
Kwak Kwa Kwa Kwam!
Immediately afterwards, huge boulders slammed into the bottom of the gorge.
Rocks collided with each other, making a roaring sound, and shattered fragments flew in all directions. Dark red flames and smoke escaped between them, and a thick layer of gray dust rose up into the sky.
It took only a fraction of a second for the huge gorge to completely collapse.
“Hoo-wook! Whoop!”
Pyowol, who had barely escaped the gorge, let out a rough breath.
The situation was so tense that even Pyo-wol, who never lost his composure, had a pale complexion.
Pyowol breathed heavily and looked at the gorge.
The canyon had collapsed so badly that it was impossible to find what it looked like when the moon first came in.
Flames were still burning from the crevices of the rocks, and the sky was full of scattered gray-white dust.
If there was a hell, I thought it would be like this.
Pyowol murmured.
“Did you know I would come?”
If so, it was clear that the other person knew very well about himself.
It was a trap that could not be unfolded without grasping the persistent sex tracking technique, psychological state, and behavioral patterns.
“under!”
After a long time, fighting spirit boiled over.
I’ve dealt with many enemies so far, but this was the first time.
The opponent was clearly aiming for himself.
It was then.
Wedge liquid!
Suddenly, a sharp piercing sound rang out.
Something was flying towards Pyowol at a frightening speed.
It’s already too late to avoid it.
Pyowol spread out the Sasa River and swung it.
See it!
The object that had been flying in with a subtle piercing sound was cut off in midair.
Damn!
The object that tumbled under Pyowol’s feet with a metallic sound was a harpoon that had been cut in two.
Pyowol looked in the direction the harpoon had come from.
The harpoon came from another tributary on the other side of the collapsed canyon.
I saw something spiky. It wasn’t too hard to figure out that it was a ship’s mast.
A man stood at the top of the mast.
A man with a huge body and hanging hair was wearing a long robe made from the skin of an unknown animal.
Truly formidable momentum emanated from his whole body.
The moment Pyowol saw the man, he recognized his identity.
“The owner of the ghost fleet.”
It was something I had seen before.
Even then, the owner of the ghost fleet had thrown a harpoon from such a long distance to keep Pyowol in check.
The owner of the ghost ship was Ko Il-won, the son of Guryongsalmakju, who was killed by Pyo-wol.
They were half siblings with So Yeo-wol, whom Pyo-wol pursued.
It was understandable that the owner of the ghost fleet was aiming for Pyowol.
Whatever the circumstances, Pyo-wol was the enemy who killed the father and grandmother of the ghost ship owner.
Ko Il-won looked at Pyowol indifferently from the top of the mast.
Pyowol also glared at him.
Despite the distance, the two could feel each other’s intense gaze.
At that moment, Ko Il-won pretended to slit his throat with his thumb.
After giving a notice of his death, Go Il-won’s appearance gradually disappeared. The ship carrying him was moving away.
Pyowol looked at the figure without a word.

chapters.title: Chapter 545
chapters.content:
Episode 545:
Gong Son-hwan, a student of martial arts, was a soldier belonging to the Geumcheonhoe.
It was only natural for him to join the Geumcheonhoe, who had been called an excellent player from a young age.
The word Seosaeng was added to the special issue, but he was not an ordinary desk bite.
The Ilwhipilbeop (一揮筆法), spread out with a pair of Pangwan’s pens, was excellent enough to be recognized as a Jeolhak of Kang Ho.
Gongsun Huan fell in love with Zhang Wujie’s ideals and joined the Jincheonhoe, becoming his limb and faithfully carrying out his duties.
On the outside, Gongsun Huan was an infallible literary figure.
Because of his handsome appearance, he won people’s favor.
In particular, women flirted with Gongsun Huan a lot.
Gongsun Huan used his appearance as a weapon to get a lot of information from the women of the Union Association.
Because a lot of information was leaked in advance, the Eunryeonhoe suffered a lot from the Geumcheonhoe.
When the Eunryeonhoe found out about this, it was after a lot of information was passed on to the Geumcheonhoe.
From then on, Gongsun Huan became the most targeted target of slaughter by the Union League. However, when Gongsun Huan’s identity was revealed, he was stuck in the realm of the Golden Heaven and did not come out.
“Whoops!”
Gongsun Huan brushed his hair and smiled.
The woman who was with him made an ecstatic expression at the sight of Gongson-hwan.
Gongsun Huan seduced the woman with his splendid rhetoric on the streets of Ligakjeon. The status of the woman was ordinary, but her appearance was very outstanding and she was popular. However, even such a woman could not make a rational decision because she was fascinated by Gongsun Huan’s outstanding looks and eloquence.
Gongsun Huan held the woman’s hand tightly and headed towards his residence.
The sun was still up in the middle of the sky, but there was no problem in sharing fortunes.
Thinking that they would soon be able to share fortunes, Gongsun Huan’s eyes and face turned red, and his breathing naturally became rough.
Then a cold voice broke his excitement.
“Gong Son-hwan, a student of martial arts. Am I right?”
“what?”
Gongsun Huan felt the blood in his whole body go cold.
It was because I read the cold emotion and hostility in her voice.
A dozen or so ahead, a man was blocking his path.
“What kind of guy are you?”
“Gongsun Huan, right?”
“Reveal your identity first.”
“Looks right.”
“Stop talking and answer. Who are you?”
“Lee Geomhan!”
“what?”
Gongsun Huan narrowed his eyes.
At first I thought I heard it wrong.
There was not a single person in the world who didn’t know the name Lee Geom-han.
Lee Geom-han of Gwangmumun.
A young warrior who is evaluated as having the greatest martial arts in the world along with Geumcheonhoeju Jang Mu-geuk.
Rumors spread that they had already formed the Doro family.
Gongsun Huan frowned and asked.
“Are you really Gwangmumun’s Lee Geomhan?”
“Yes.”
“good! I really call it this swordsman. But why did you block me? We wouldn’t have any money.”
“You don’t have to have Eun-won to block the front.”
“What do you mean?”
“I have no personal feelings, but you should be my stepping stone.”
“her!”
Gongsun Huan looked around with a spirited expression. It was because I was wondering if Lee Geom-han had any support troops. However, there were no people who could help Lee Geom-han anywhere.
A smile appeared on Gongsun Huan’s lips.
This was the realm of the Golden Temple.
Most of the warriors on this street supported the Geumcheonhoe.
The opponent named Lee Geom-han was burdensome, but the story is different if you deal with him in the realm of Geumcheonhoe.
Even a mutt eats half of it at his house, and he had no reason to be intimidated. Gongsun Huan took out a pair of Pangwan pils and held them in his hand.
“So you are challenging me now. Lee Geomhan of the world…”
“I am honored to know. I’m not challenging anyone like this.”
“good! take it as an honor Instead, pay the price with your life.”
Chun!
Gongsun Huan took the flag-bearing ceremony holding a pangwan-pil.
Ilhwipilbeop, as the name suggests, was a martial art derived from the writing method.
As if scribbled with a single stroke, it was a school that had to be supported by a proud flow and strong momentum.
“Ha!”
With a spirit, Gongsun Huan rushed at Yi Geomhan.
He didn’t do anything stupid, like giving up his superiors for the sake of face.
The opponent announced his intention to challenge, and he had no intention of avoiding it.
Although Lee Geom-han’s reputation was a little burdensome, he did not think that he would fall behind him much.
While attacking, other warriors of the Geumcheonhoe will surely come running. If he held on until then, it would be his victory.
Shia!
A pair of Panggwanpil wrote in the air with one stroke.
Each and every letter written in the air turned into Jeolcho, aiming for Lee Geom-Han’s blood.
“wow!”
“what?”
The people nearby were startled and burst into security.
The sudden duel of unmanned people widened their eyes and cheered.
Moreover, Gongsun Huan’s martial arts were so elegant that it was a pleasure to watch.
They thought that Gongsun Huan’s Pangwanpil would pierce Lee Geomhan’s body. Because it was so sharp and powerful.
‘It’s nothing. Was he impersonating Lee Geomhan?’
Gongsun-hwan thought so when he saw Lee Geom-han, who did not move until just before Pangwan-pil touched his body.
See it!
Suddenly, a shrill roar reverberated through the street.
“Keugh!”
“100 million!”
The terrifying sound of gong pierced the eardrums of those around them and shook their brains.
People covered their ears and screamed, and the streets turned into chaos in an instant.
It was long after that that people came to their senses.
What caught the eyes of those who managed to get up was a body lying on the floor.
“Unbelievable!”
“ah!”
People were astonished.
Because the body lying on the floor was Gongsun Huan.
Near the corpse, pieces of the judge’s pen were cut into pieces.
People were astonished at the unbelievable results.
“What happened?”
“It’s clear that this business is divided.”
“oh my god!”
Gongsunhuan’s body was cut horizontally from the chest.
It was clear that the weapon and body had been severed in a single blow.
It was clearly a battle in which Gongsun Huan had an advantage.
Everyone thought so.
This is because it occupied an advantageous position as a pioneer. Even so, he lost his life without being able to fight against a single sword.
It was a truly shocking result.
“Is this Dao Guang’s real skill?”
“Crazy! it’s crazy!”
People looked at Gongsun Huan’s dead body and looked tired.
Rumors that Gongson-Hwan of Geumcheonhoe was attacked by Do-Gwang Lee Geom-Han soon spread throughout Poyang Lake.
＊＊＊
Yong Ha-sang’s eyebrows twitched.
“What did you say?”
“Lee Geomhan said he cut Gongsun Huan with one sword.”
“Is it really?”
“That’s how the report came in.”
Namgungwol calmly answered Yong Ha-sang’s question.
He, who was reporting, was also quite surprised. Even so, he was able to maintain such a calm expression because he thought Lee Geom-han’s appearance was a good thing for the union.
Wherever there is water, it will rot.
It was the same with the situation at the current union meeting.
After Yong Ha-sang became the head of the party, the Union Association was stagnant, and ruptures were heard from everywhere.
Yong Ha-sang did not have the will to win the fight against Geumcheonhoe. Through the confrontation with Geumcheonhoe, it was possible to see the idea of further solidifying his status.
Because of that, he was unable to gain a clear advantage in the fight against Geumcheonhoe.
Yong Ha-sang asked.
“Do you know why Geomhan Lee killed Gongsun Huan? Have you ever had Eun-won before?”
“I don’t know that far.”
“hmm!”
Yong Ha-sang stroked his chin with his hand and frowned.
Gongsun Huan was designated as the number one target to be killed by the Union Association. If such a person died, I should feel refreshed, but for some reason my appetite was bitter.
I don’t know exactly why, but it meant that there was something stuck somewhere in my heart.
“Where is Lee Geom-han now?”
“I don’t know!”
“Wouldn’t it be somewhere in Lake Poyang? You still haven’t figured it out?”
“I am looking into it now. It will take time.”
“her! Are you saying that now? No matter how vast Poyang Lakeside is, you can’t find a single trace of Lee Geom-han with the power of the Union Association? Are you telling me to believe that right now?”
“after! Whether you believe it or not, what I say is true.”
“Noisy! Find him now and bring him before me. This is an order given by the head of the union association.”
“Okay… I see.”
Namgungwol answered with a chin twitch.
His face was contorted with humiliation.
After leaving Yong Ha-sang’s residence, Namgungwol muttered as he watched Hoejujeon.
“I was wrong. I didn’t put him on the board.”
In fact, he intended to run the Union Association himself, with Yong Ha-sang as the head of the party.
It was because he thought it was the way to serve the Union Association and the world. However, as Yong Ha-sang’s dogma grew stronger, he felt skeptical and regretful about his judgment.
However, he couldn’t get Wah Yong Ha-sang out of the post of Hoeju now.
There is no way to force it, and above all, Yonghasang will not give it up.
It was a dragon that already had power in its hands.
Those who have tasted power never come down on their own. It was the same with Yonghasang.
“Whoa!”
Namgungwol took a step forward and let out a sigh.
It felt stuffy as if a large rock had been placed on my chest.
The fact that he couldn’t express his frustration to anyone made it even more painful for him.
In any case, the owner, Yong Ha-sang, gave the order, so we had to follow it.
It was when he diligently moved to convey the order of the Lord to his subordinates.
“You look busy.”
Suddenly, a cold woman’s voice was heard.
Namgungwol stopped walking at the familiar voice.
“sister!”
The woman who spoke to him was his older sister Namgung Seol.
At her appearance, the impression of Namgungwol, who was already distorted, was further frowned.
“How did you get in here?”
“Is that something you would say to a blood relative you haven’t seen in a long time?”
“The one who didn’t treat me as a blood relative was my sister. You haven’t forgotten, have you?”
“after! What can I say to you? I’m afraid to talk to you because everything is so sharp.”
“I don’t do this to anyone else. I’m doing this because I’m your sister.”
Namgungwol’s voice and attitude were so cold that it could hardly be said that he was talking to a blood relative of the same bloodline.
Knowing that the reason was because of himself, Namgungseol could not refute it any longer.
Namgungwol said.
“say! How did you get in?”
“I let you in.”
The answer was given by someone other than Namgungseol.
Instead of Namgungseol, the person who answered was a woman her age.
She was Yeom Hee-soo, the owner of Hwayeongchae’s soybean vegetable.
It was a member of Kang Ho with the nickname Baekmyeonhwa (百面花).
“Why salt sauce?”
“It’s because of the dragon master.”
“what?”
“Namgung Sohyup is also very disappointed with Yong Hoeju’s recent behavior. Same for me. Yong Hui-ju is not the kind of person to lead a large group.”
“What does that have to do with letting your sister in?”
“there is. Even Namgung Sohyeop will know if she listens to her.”
Yeom Hee-soo’s words confused Namgung-wol even more.
Yeom Hee-soo was the closest person to Yong Ha-sang. I really didn’t expect her to change her face so suddenly.
Namgungwol looked at Namgungseol.
“What plot are you plotting?”
“What is the conspiracy… I just want to let you know.”
“What?”
“The fact that a strong competitor of Yonghoeju will appear soon. He will destroy the equipment of the Golden Heaven one after another, and he will blow his prestige to the river. After winning a series of victories like that, I’m going to challenge the dragon master.”
“Is that competitor… Lee Geom-han?”
“Whoops!”
“Crazy…”
“Then you have enough qualifications to become the head of the Union Federation, don’t you?”

chapters.title: Chapter 546
chapters.content:
Episode 546
Rumors about Lee Geom-han were spreading beyond Poyang Lake and all over Gangho.
Every day, Lee Geom-han asked the warriors of the Geumcheonhoe to fight. The result was a winning streak.
The best equipment and masters within the Geumcheonhoe knelt before Geomhan Lee.
Until now, the existence of Lee Geom-han was highly regarded as a counter-horse to Jang Moo-geuk.
He was so crazy about Dao that he earned the nickname Do-gwang, but he rarely showed his skills in front of people.
People tended not to believe what they did not see with their own eyes. It was the same in the case of Lee Geum-han. So, implicitly, people thought that Lee Geomhan might have been overrated.
However, his actions at Lake Poyang were enough to dispel people’s doubts.
It felt like he was the only one fighting against the Geumcheonhoe now that the Poyangho River Warfare had reached a lull.
People were enthusiastic about Lee Geom-han’s move.
It was a picture of a hero who had endured so far, drawing the sword of justice because he could not see the great tribulation of the river.
The dramatic appearance of an unexpected hero made people cheer.
“Who are you going to deal with this time?”
“It’s also Gwangmumun. Is the one and only heir such a great thief?”
“Isn’t this enough to be the first pilgrim in the world?”
People talked about Lee Geom-han whenever there were more than two of them.
Pyowol muttered as he looked around the street.
“It feels like watching a well-organized miscellaneous drama. After all, it must be Namgungseol’s work, right?”
Under normal circumstances, no matter how great an individual’s inaction or unconventional move, he would not be able to rise to such a high level of attention.
It was possible only if someone intentionally reproduced and spread the topic.
Pyo-wol thought that Namgung-seol was the main agent.
He had the ability to do so, and above all, he was full of will.
She was ready to jump in at any cost for Lee Geom-han.
Lee Geom-han’s move was also unconventional, but Namgung-seol’s ability to help him was also great.
People who don’t know their relationship will never know about this unusual situation.
“If there had been a violent eruption, I would have liked it because it was fun.”
After the breakup, there was no news of how Sogyeoksan was doing.
Although they had not contacted him once, Pyo-wol thought that So Gyeok-san was doing well and hoped that he would.
Pyowol suddenly raised his head and looked around.
A familiar landscape unfolded before my eyes.
Huge mansions were lined up in rows.
Even at a glance, it was a town far away from the place where ordinary grassroots live.
It was a street where high-ranking officials and influential people gathered.
Among them, a huge manor stood out.
“Haerojang?”
It was the name of the manor written on the board.
It was time for Pyowol, who had been looking at Haerojang for a while, to turn back.
“You’ve come this far, why are you just leaving?”
A muffled old woman’s voice was heard.
Pyo-wol turned around and saw an old woman standing with a cane.
The old woman with a bent back was looking at Pyowol with eyes dripping with ooze.
The old woman struggled to approach Pyowol.
“Pyo Daehyeop, right?”
“that’s right!”
“As expected, my eyes were not mistaken. I thought it was long because I was wearing a hat. Hee hee!”
The old woman looked at the moon and laughed.
Pyo-wol said as he took off the hat he was wearing on his head.
“How did you find out?”
“Did you tell me? I like my keen eye.”
“Awesome. At that age…”
“Hehe! Actually, I was lucky. Now my eyes are blurry and I can’t see very well. I just filmed it because it felt the same.”
The old woman was Roh Tae-tae, the owner of Haerojang.
Roh Tae-tae couldn’t stop laughing, perhaps because he was happy to meet Pyo-wol by chance. Then, breathing stopped and he coughed.
“Cool! Cool!”
Pyowol hurriedly helped Roh Tae-tae.
Roh Tae-tae coughed as if he would run out of breath at any moment. Pyo-wol calmed her down by injecting a little energy into her Myeongmun-hyeol.
“are you okay?”
“Thank you! I owe you again.”
“Why did you come out alone?”
“I came out alone because it was in front of my house.”
“Go inside.”
“Can you help me?”
At Noh Tae-tae’s words, Pyo-wol nodded.
Pyo-wol helped Roh Tae-tae and went to Haerojang.
As soon as I entered the sea route, the commander-in-chief hurriedly came running. He was surprised by Roh Tae-tae’s pale complexion.
“Are you okay?”
“Hee hee! I’m fine. Here, Pyo Daehyeop took care of me.”
“ah!”
It was only then that the commander-in-chief recognized Pyowol and was startled. However, he soon calmed down and greeted him politely.
“Thank you for taking care of Roh Tae-tae.”
“I don’t think your health has gotten much worse than before.”
“yes! You’ve lost a lot of energy lately. He needs care, but he keeps insisting on going for walks alone.”
It was Roh Tae-tae, who was over a hundred years old.
It was such an age that it wouldn’t be strange if he died at any time. However, I managed my health well for my age, so I was quite correct.
The moment Roh Tae-tae lost his energy was just before the Great War broke out, right after his great-grandson Ju Seol-pung joined the Union Association.
From then on, his energy rapidly declined, making everyone at the top of the Jewon worry.
The biggest problem is that Noh Tae-tae refuses to take care of people.
Pyowol looked at Noh Tae-tae.
‘Am I preparing for death alone?’
Among those who were close to death, there was a person who pushed the people around him.
It is to cut off affection in advance so that those left behind feel less sorrow.
Perhaps Roh Tae-tae was preparing for his own death with such an intuition.
Come to think of it, Roh Tae-tae’s eyes were full of white dust.
The gun you saw when you met before is no longer felt.
Roh Tae-tae smiled and said, probably feeling Pyo-wol’s gaze.
“I’m fine, but they say they’re making a fuss. No need to worry. Because I am so healthy.”
“I guess so.”
“Now that we’ve met before, why don’t we have a cup of tea?”
“I will.”
“Hee hee! Come here. Even if it wasn’t, there was no one to drink tea with, so it was lonely.”
Roh Tae-tae caught the pyowol and led him to the patronage.
The tactile feel of the hand that was holding it was rough. But the warmth was still there.
Roh Tae-tae, who finally arrived at the patronage, started brewing tea with a happy expression.
After hearing the rattling sound for a while, Noh Tae-tae put the teacup in front of Pyo-wol.
“Drink.”
“hmm!”
Pyowol raised the teacup and brought it to his lips.
The fragrant smell stimulated the sense of smell.
“It’s a nice car.”
“To be honest, I can’t even taste the food anymore because my sense of taste is gone. It’s the only one I can taste the tea.”
“A man like that is great for us.”
“is it? I am glad that the messenger of the world said so.”
Noh Tae-tae smiled broadly.
All of his teeth were lost, and only his gums were visible. Still, it didn’t look ugly.
Pyowol took a sip of the tea and put the glass down.
“What about the blizzard?”
“Hee hee! I haven’t seen him since.”
“Would you like to see it?”
“I miss you a lot. Still, among my great-grandsons, there is no child as affectionate as that child.”
“Don’t you regret sending it out like that?”
“Is it not possible? It would be nice if you supported that child, but if something goes wrong, everything at the top of the jewon will collapse. this is the best It is correct that this side organizes the ledger so that it can go the way I want.”
Noah Tae-tae smiled.
It was still warm, but it was a smile that somehow seemed lonely.
She and the Jewon Sangdan completely cut ties with Ju Seol-pung.
If the Eunnyeonhoe, which Ju Seol-pung belongs to, becomes the winner of the Great War, their relationship will be restored. However, if Eunryeonhoe loses and Geumcheonhoe wins, they will live as strangers forever.
Blood relatives could criticize it for being too cold-hearted, but it was something both sides agreed on.
Roh Tae-tae wanted to protect the jewon top, and Ju Seol-pung agreed with his great-grandmother’s idea.
Noh Tae-tae looked up at the sky and said.
“The top of the jewon is nothing more than shackles, not wings for that child. What could be more pitiful than a person with great aspirations trapped in such a narrow cage and unable to flap his wings?”
“So are you satisfied?”
“What can I do to be content and sleep? Just hearing that it flaps its wings on its own is enough for me.”
“is it?”
“Yes.”
There was still a small smile on Noah’s lips.
Pyowol held up the teacup without a word.
Slurp!
Although it cooled down a bit, the tea was still delicious.
Pyowol suddenly spoke to her.
“If you have any leftover tea leaves, give them some.”
“Do you like it?”
“Juseolpung was also my favorite tea. I will bring it to you.”
“Mmm!”
Roh Tae-tae’s eyebrows trembled at Pyo-wol’s unexpected reply.
Pyowol was still drinking tea with a blunt expression.
A bright smile appeared on Noh Tae-tae’s lips as he watched the scene.
“Thank you for doing so. Please wait a bit.”
It was Roh Tae-tae and the Jewon Sang-dan, who did not contact Ju Seol-pung at all because they were conscious of Geumcheonhoe’s gaze.
The main snow wind also didn’t even come close to the top of the temple.
Even though they are together by Poyang Lake, they act as if they are strangers. Because of that, I had to hold back even if there was something I wanted to hand over. However, the story is different if the pewol is caught in the middle.
Pyowol’s status in Gangho was truly great.
Not only did he rise to the highest peak as an assassin, but he did not belong anywhere in the political world.
Depending on which side he takes, the direction of the game will be different.
The moon was clearly not taking either side.
If you carelessly touch the sign and he raises the other side, the problem becomes serious.
Because of that, both factions were still refraining from hasty approaches to Pyowol.
In a way, Pyowol was the safest and most reliable person in the world.
Roh Tae-tae wrapped the tea leaves and several items in a cloth to send to Ju Seol-pung. Roh Tae-tae’s warmth seemed to be contained in the crudely tied cloth knot.
Roh Tae-tae handed Pyo-wol a wrapping cloth.
“Then please.”
“Do you have anything else to say?”
“It’s just… you’re doing great. Just tell me that.”
“Do that.”
Pyowol answered while accepting the wrapping cloth.
Roh Tae-tae looked at Pyo-wol with a happy expression and said as if he had suddenly remembered it.
“really! Do you need anything?”
“doesn’t exist!”
“Father said that useful items came into the report. Go see it, though?”
“it’s okay! I have no desire to be rewarded with something like this.”
“If you need any help from the Bone Merchant, let me know. Because the door is always wide open to Pyo Dae-hyeop.”
“I’ll go.”
“already?”
“I’ll come back later.”
“Hee hee! I’ll wait.”
Roh Tae-tae smiled, exposing his missing teeth.
Pyo-wol looked at the scene quietly and came out.
As soon as he came out, Pyo-wol put on the hat attached to his bloody wind.
In Pyo-wol’s hand, which had left the seaport, he was holding a small bundle.
The place Pyo-wol headed was where the Union Reunion was located.
Like the Geumcheonhoe, the Eunryeonhoe also used a large manor as their base.
The huge manor was reborn as a fortress through repeated extensions.
There has never been a case in which two powers faced each other and faced each other across a huge lake.
Even though it was late in the evening, quite a lot of people were coming and going on the street where the union association was based.
Most of the people here were uninhabited.
There were soldiers who belonged to the Union Association, and there were those who were waiting to enter the Union Association.
Among them, there were also cadres to monitor the movement of the Union Association.
So many people were staying on the same street, hiding their respective desires.
Pyo-wol went into a large inn in front of the main entrance of the Union Association.
As he took his seat by the window overlooking Union Hall, Jeom So-yi came running.
“welcome. Would you like to order a meal?”
“Bring me something simple.”
“Would it be stir-fried pork and rice?”
“okay! And run an errand for you.”
“Are you running errands?”
Jeom Soi looked at him with a puzzled expression.
Pyowol said to him.
“There must be a person named Ju Seol-pung in the union association. Tell him that he has a visitor.”
“Why do you do that to me?”
“Because you are Haomundo.”
“How?”
Jeom So-yi’s eyes twitched. This is because Pyo-wol recognized his identity that no one else knew.
“My name is Pyowol.”
“ah! Please wait a little bit. I will tell you soon.”
Just the name Pyowol explained everything.
Jeom So-yi quickly ran outside, and Pyo-wol, who was left alone, looked at the union association.

chapters.title: Chapter 547
chapters.content:
Episode 547
While he was eating alone, someone approached his seat.
“Pyo… Daehyup?”
It was Ju Seol-pung who spoke cautiously to Pyo-wol.
“sit down!”
“Right.”
Ju Seol-pung carefully looked around and sat down in front of Pyo-wol.
Pyowol lifted his hat and looked at the snow wind.
He seemed a little haggard, probably because he was having a lot of trouble these days. But his eyes were still full of light.
“You seem to be doing well.”
“I am busy.”
“How is the Union Association?”
“sorry. No matter how much it is, I can’t tell you the situation inside the eunryeonhoe. Please understand.”
“I understand!”
“thank you. But how did you get here?”
“It’s on the way to Haerojang.”
“Ha…is that what the chief said?”
“okay!”
“ah!”
The main snow wind let out an exclamation involuntarily.
His eyes were shaking.
No matter how much he cut ties with the Jewon Corps, the safety of his great-grandmother Roh Tae-tae was still his foremost concern.
“How is your great-grandmother?”
“How are you still holding on?”
“Isn’t it very bad?”
“Looks like you’ve lost a lot of energy.”
“ah!”
The snow wind let out a sigh involuntarily.
Roh Tae-tae was already over a hundred years old.
Since he had enjoyed his life long enough, it was not strange when his lifespan ended. I was prepared that in the worst case, I would not be able to attend her funeral, but when I heard it through Pyowol’s mouth, my mood calmed down.
Pyo-wol held out a bundle to Ju Seol-pung.
“receive!”
“What is it?”
“Roh Tae-tae sent it to you. It contains tea leaves and a few more items. I sent you all of your favorites.”
“thank you. thank you.”
Ju Seol-pung gave thanks and handed over the bundle.
As if it were a rare treasure in the world, Ju Seol-pung hugged the bundle tightly.
It was as if he could feel Roh Tae-tae’s warmth in the wrapping cloth.
Snow White’s eyes turned red.
After a while, he raised his head and looked at Pyowol.
he was laughing hard
“Thank you for giving me such a precious gift. I don’t know how to repay this.”
“It’s not difficult, so what’s the reward…”
“Whoa! It may not be a big deal to Pyo Dae-hyeop, but to me it is a precious gift that cannot be exchanged for anything.”
“Then go in.”
Pyowol stood up.
Ju Seol-pung’s share in the union meeting was by no means small.
He was running a union association with Namgoongwol.
In particular, because he had been at the top for a long time, his sense of handling money and his skills in handling people were excellent.
There was so much to do that I couldn’t leave even for a moment.
At least it was Pyowol who was the one to meet, so he didn’t force himself to come out like this, otherwise he wouldn’t have dared to leave.
Knowing that fact, Pyowol stood up right away.
It was when Ju Seol-pung was about to say thanks to Pyo-wol.
Dang dang dang!
Suddenly, an urgent bell rang from the Union Hall.
It was a ringing bell signaling an emergency.
Pyowol and Juseolpung simultaneously looked at the union meeting.
Suddenly, there was a busy movement in the direction of the front gate of the union association.
In an unusually urgent movement, Ju Seol-pung packed a bundle and spoke to Pyo-wol.
“It seems that there has been a change in the meeting. Let’s go first.”
“Do it.”
“then!”
After Ju Seol-pung grabbed Pyo-wol, he hurriedly ran to the union meeting.
Left alone, Pyowol sat down again.
Now that I’ve come this far, I thought I’d go and see what was going on.
It was then.
cooong!
Suddenly, a dull air wave swept through the area.
“Keugh!”
“Hup!”
Everyone in the inn held their chests and groaned in agony.
Pyo-wol looked for the subject of Ki-pa with interesting eyes.
The source of the kipa was a man who was approaching the Silver Reunion from afar.
A man with a bold impression wearing a sword around his waist.
A mountain-like momentum emanated from him.
Pyo-wol recognized the man at once.
“Lee Geomhan!”
＊＊＊
Kwajik!
Yong Ha-sang crumpled the letter he was reading a while ago.
The correspondence was a kind of challenge.
[Yong Ha-sang Hoeju’s personal battle.
Today, I will challenge Yong Ha-sang Hoiju with the Jinju of the Unryeonhoe.
I believe that if I am not afraid, I will accept the challenge.
―Compensation for this sword.]
To put it simply, it was a story about fighting for the position of president of the Union Association.
Yong Ha-sang had no obligation to respond to this.
The gigantic force called Union Reunion was not a toy for children.
It is not something that can be handed over in just one confrontation and then received again.
Of course, Yong Ha-sang could refuse Lee Geom-han’s challenge.
The problem was face.
If the owner of Eunryeonhoe and the owner of Yongcheongok evades Lee Geomhan’s challenge, everyone will curse and criticize him for being a coward.
Face is the most useless thing in the world, but I couldn’t just ignore it.
This is because warriors do not follow those who have lost face.
That’s why sometimes I had to risk my life to save face. Such a harsh world was strong.
Furthermore, Lee Geom-han had recently been gaining a reputation as fiery.
By capturing the masters of the Geumcheonhoe one after another, the status pierces the sky.
If he shied away from such a challenge, people would look down on him and not follow him.
There weren’t many subordinates who could follow Hoe-ju, whose status had fallen to the bottom.
“under! Then, was fighting the warriors of the Geumcheonhoe one after another a paving stone for this?”
Only then did I understand why Lee Geom-han took such a reckless step.
It was truly a perfect outing.
I don’t know who drew it, but it was simple and perfect.
There was no way out anywhere.

There is no chance to stick, so if you collide head-on, you can always win.

When I thought of Namgungseol, goose bumps ran through my body.
It was then.
Dang dang dang!

Yong Ha-sang kicked off his seat and stood up.
“Looks like you’re here.”
As he stretched out his hand, the sword that was hanging on the wall flew out and caught it in his hand.
Yong Ha-sang said, holding a sword around his waist.

Yong Ha-sang walked past them and came out.

Geomhan Lee’s whole body was flowing with heavy momentum like a mountain.
“Lee Geomhan!”
“Long time no see. Dragon Ha!”
The two recognized each other.
Even though we didn’t actively interact with each other, we still saw each other’s faces a few times.
Yong Ha-sang walked to where Lee Geom-han was.
“I’ve been hearing a lot about you lately.”
“is it? I’ve been diligently moving these days. It seems that the rumor has reached your ears.”
“Why did you do that?”

“I’m just going to stay at Gwangmumun, so why come all this far and mess around?”
“Breaking up?”

“I think it would be good to think a little and then talk. It’s a problem because you always speak first without going through your brain.”
“Are you insulting me now?”
The dragon’s voice became sharper. In spite of his young voice, Lee Geom-han answered with an unwavering expression.
“No, I’m just telling the truth.”
“If I move the federation here, you are finished.”

“Why are you so sure? There is no reason for me to give up my advantage and fight you head-on.”

chapters.content:
Episode 548
The man watching the confrontation between Lee Geom-han and Yong Ha-sang in the inn was clear.

After thinking for a while, Namgungseol licked his lips.

―Pyowol is in the guest cup. Everyone keep an eye on him and attack him if he shows signs of intervening in a fight.

It was then.
“I’ll just go there.”
Suddenly, a woman’s low voice came from behind Namgungseol.
In an instant, a cold sweat ran down Namgungseol’s back.

Being so close together and not noticing it meant that the opponent had mastered a martial art that specialized in hiding their presence and presence.

Namgungseol happened to know such a woman.
“It is you.”
she said without looking back.

“How can I forget an assassin like you? But guts are good too. To come here on my own feet.”
“I’ve heard a lot of stories like that before.”
The woman standing behind Namgungseol and answering calmly was Hong Yeseol.
Hong Ye-seol’s gaze was fixed on the Pyowol in front of Namgung-seol.
“He has no intention of getting involved in this fight. So, leave your men behind.”
“How can I believe that?”
“It doesn’t matter if you don’t believe me. If you don’t listen to me, it will only hurt you and your man.”
“You are shameless. Who caused this sadal to appear like this? Are all assassins as brazen as you?”
“For an assassin, this is the basics.”
“Don’t you feel responsible for this situation? You killed Chilhyeonstudent and the Gangho War broke out.”
“I am a kind of tool. The person who made the request is the problem, and there is no reason for me to take responsibility for this.”
“Are you going to get away?”
“I have already paid the price. You’re the one who doesn’t force yourself.”
Hong Ye-seol’s calm answer made Namgung-seol frown.
I wanted to turn around and attack Hong Ye-seol right away. However, there was no way Hong Ye-seol would let that happen.
From the moment the rear was occupied, it was an absolutely unfavorable situation for Namgungseol.
As of now, there was no reasonable way to overcome this situation.
Namgungseol, who grieved for a while, sounded a telephony again to Seolhwa Swordsman.
―Everyone, please step back from the inn. withdraw the order.
At her command, Seolhwa Swordsman put on a puzzled expression for a moment. However, as soon as she ordered, he withdrew from the inn.
Namgungseol asked.
“Are you done now?”
“…”
But no answer came from behind.
Only then did Namgoongseol cautiously look back.
“profit!”
Namgungseol gritted his teeth in shame.
This is because Hong Ye-seol, who had been threatening her until now, was nowhere to be seen.
It was ashamed of her that she felt no presence when she disappeared as when she appeared.
I looked around, but I couldn’t find Hong Ye-seol anywhere.
If Hong Ye-seol had the will to live, the fact that he was dead in the first place was creepy.
In a head-to-head confrontation, he would never lose, but his life was in danger if he made an ambush like this.
She felt a strong sense of crisis.
It was the first time I felt this level of danger after learning martial arts.
‘I will never let you go. I will pursue and kill him even to the end of hell.’
Namgungseol’s eyes were bloodshot.
It was then.
Quaang!
Suddenly, a loud bang rang out.
Namgungseol suddenly came to his senses and looked ahead.
Lee Geom-han and Yong Ha-sang were clashing.
Neither of them even pulled out the Tao.
It started with bare fists.
Both of them mainly used martial arts, but were also familiar with martial arts with their bare hands.
There was nothing better than a fist when it came to measuring the power of an opponent.
Kwak!
As the two fists collided, an extended explosion erupted.
One was the successor of Yongcheongok, one of the three troupes, and the other was the grand duke of Gwangmumun, one of the Yi Gangs.
Both of them mastered the teachings of Yongcheongok and Gwangmumun to the highest level.
Every herbivore he spread with his bare fists was a season of rise.
Bubbubuck!
The fists of the two crossed and intertwined countless times.
Every time the air burst out and the floor was puffy.
“Keugh!”
“Stand back.”
The onlookers hurriedly backed away at the formidable airwaves.
If I stayed there, I could have been swept away by air waves and lost my life.
Yong Ha-sang said while throwing a fist.
“It’s amazing, Lee Geomhan!”
“You are.”
I couldn’t help but admit it.
Both Yong Ha-sang and Lee Geom-han deeply understood the extreme meaning of martial arts.
It’s been a long time since I had such an opponent.
A smile formed on Lee Geum-han’s lips.
Yong Ha-sang was the first opponent to push himself this far since Pyo-wol.
It was to the point where I couldn’t understand why he was so passive against Geumcheonhoe with such great martial arts.
“Ha!”
Yonghasang threw out his fist with all his might. In his fist, a group of intense lights gathered.
“It’s Guo Kwon Kang.”
“Yong Hoeju has released Kwon Kang.”
“wow!”
An exclamation burst out.
It was the first time for everyone to see an unmanned person who had risen to the point where he could unleash Kwon Kang freely.
Lee Ki Seong-gang (以氣成罡) was nothing short of proof of his absolute adherence.
Being an absolute master meant that Yong Ha-sang’s military strength was one of the strongest.
Wow!
Kwon Kang flew to Lee Geom-Han with terrifying momentum.
People wondered how Lee Geom-han would respond.
There was no reason to confront Kwon Kang head-on.
Rather, avoiding it or spilling it to the side could have been a more sensible response. But Lee Geum-han did not.
Being an unmanned person means being strong and an unmanned man who leads the times should never show weakness.
I had to show myself to face any trials and threats head-on. So people believe in him and follow him.
Lee Geom-han thought of himself as the one who would lead Kang-ho.
I was taught that way from a young age, and I always had the idea that I should do it.
“Chaa!”
Lee Geom-han threw his fist at the flying Gwon Kang.
In an instant, a strong light flared up in his fist.
“It’s Guo Kwon Kang.”
“This Grand Hyeop also unfolded its power.”
Wow!
At that moment, Kwon Kang and Kwon Kang collided.
As if a meteorite had fallen, a tremendous explosion and air waves swept the area.
“Huh!”
“Keck!”
People who were swept away by the air wave were blown in all directions like withered leaves.
At least, only the warriors who have mastered martial arts to a high level stand firm. But even their faces showed signs of tension and surprise.
Farr!
Goosebumps ran over their skin.
It was a great fortune to be born as a soldier and watch a fight of this level.
My eyes go up just by seeing this level of dance.
As much as the eye level, the understanding of martial arts increases and becomes devoted.
In particular, those who reached a certain level of martial arts would gain enlightenment just by watching such a high-level confrontation.
The warriors could not take their eyes off the confrontation between the two.
After a while, the storm-like air waves subsided and the two figures were revealed.
It was hard to believe that Kwon Kang clashed, so the two were fine.
The only difference was that Yong Ha-sang’s face turned a little more red.
Yong Ha-sang grabbed the handle of the sword and said.
“I don’t think we’ll be able to win easily with punches.”
“I agree.”
Lee Geomhan also grabbed the handle of the sword.
For both of them, the name season was a gimmick.
Until now, it was just a taste, and now it’s real.
Whoa!
The two pointed their swords at each other. Then, great momentum came out.
“Chaa!”
The first to move was Yonghasang.
Weeing!
The sword in his hand flew towards Lee Geom-Han with a terrifying blast.
In an instant, Lee Geum-han’s eyes softened coldly.
He sprang forward with a slight bend at the waist.
It was a step called Hoiryunbo (回輪步) that paired with the thousand-year-old sword.
Shia!
His sword was swung with terrifying momentum.
Dodo collided with Dodo.
Caang!
At the same time, Tao burst into tears.
“Keugh!”
“Ears, ears…”
People were suffering as they covered their ears with their hands at the sharp provocation.
Even if I covered my ears, it was no use.
The crying Do Myung dug into people’s brains and shook them all.
One after another, people fell.
There were only a handful of warriors standing on their own two legs.
Among them were Namgungwol and Juseolpung.
Watching the clash between Lee Geom-han and Yong Ha-sang, their faces were dark.
It was seemingly an equal fight.
It seemed that no one was able to overwhelm the opponent and fought fiercely. However, the two knew very well that this was not the case.
“It’s over.”
“Whew!”
The two fired a shotgun at the same time.
The dragon’s projection was obviously amazing.
As befits the martial arts of the prestigious Yongcheongok, it was a skill that would prevail throughout the world.
But the opponent was bad.
The name of the sword that Lee Geom-han learned was Thousand Kills.
It was Lee Gwak’s method of making Gwangmumun, one of the two rivers in the world, with a single sword.
In terms of power alone, it was by far the best swordsman in the world.
I don’t know to what extent Lee Geom-han had mastered the Thousand Killing Sword, but if the power of the sword was simply taken into account, Yongcheongok’s sword could not match the Thousand Kill Sword.
They knew very well how great Yongha-san’s pride was. However, if he really wanted to defeat Lee Geom-han, he would have to use a martial art other than swordsmanship.
It was impossible to defeat the Thousand Swordsman with Yongcheongok’s skill.
At least that’s what they thought.
Kakakakang!
A continuous rustling sound rang out.
The two of them could no longer be seen.
It is moving at a terrifying speed that is difficult to detect with the naked eye.
Follow me!
The speed at which Tao and Tao collided gradually increased.
The confrontation is approaching its climax.
That’s how people’s hearts also beat fast.

One was standing with his sword hanging down on the floor, and the other was on one knee.
