“Wow! The great swordsman won.”
“Do-gwang defeated the So Pae-ryong.”
The one standing upright was Lee Geom-han, and the one kneeling on one knee with bloodstains on his mouth was Yong Ha-sang.
It was the moment when the head of the Eunryeonhoe passed from Yong Ha-sang to Lee Geom-han.

chapters.title: Chapter 549
chapters.content:
Episode 549
Pyo-wol watched the fight between Yong Ha-sang and Lee Geom-han from beginning to end.
He was the only one who followed their movements to the end, which most unmanned soldiers could not follow.
That’s why I knew better than anyone how great the level of the two was.
In the end, Lee Geom-han won, but Yong Ha-sang’s martial arts were truly amazing.
Yonghasang’s shoulders were shaking.
Confident of victory, he accepted Lee Geom-han’s challenge, but the result was his disastrous defeat.
I couldn’t lift my head from the humiliation.
He was more proud than anyone else.
He was so confident in his powerlessness.
I didn’t even think about losing in this fight.
As always, he was sure that the winner of this confrontation would be himself.
Because of that, I hadn’t even thought about how I would react when defeated.
After suffering an unexpected defeat, I didn’t know how to behave.
When he looked up, he seemed to see everyone laughing at him. So I couldn’t even raise my head.
Then, Lee Geom-han held out his hand to him.
“I admired your martial arts. How about continuing to help me without leaving the union association?”
Yong Ha-sang’s face became more distorted with humiliation.
“Are you insulting me now?”
“I mean it from the bottom of my heart.”
“Noisy! Don’t insult me any more. Even though I lost because of lack of martial arts, I am not the person who will receive this kind of sympathy.”
“It’s not sympathy…”
“That’s it!”
widely!
Yong Ha-sang removed Lee Geom-han’s hand and stood up.
“Don’t insult me any further.”
He glared at Lee Geom-han with bloodshot eyes, then turned around.
It was only then that the faces of the people who were looking at him came into his eyes.
Faces stained with astonishment and shock were clearly visible.
Knock!
The Dragon King gnashed his teeth.
After staring at the warlords in silence for a moment, he shouted loudly.
“It is my defeat. Now, the union association will be led by Lee Geom-han.”
After declaring his defeat, he moved among the warlords.
No one dared to stop him.
Suddenly, Yong Ha-sang stopped in front of Namgung-wol.
“That would be nice!”
“river bed?”
“Haven’t you always liked me? Now that I don’t have to see my face anymore, I feel relieved.”
“How can you say that?”
“Am I wrong? I know all about how much you’re having fun inside.”
“Whoa!”
Namgungwol let out a deep sigh instead of answering.
It was useless to make any excuses to Yong Ha-sang, whose heart was tightly twisted.
“Let’s go together. Let’s talk as we go.”
“Okay! I don’t need any sympathy.”
Yong Ha-sang pushed past Namgung-wol’s shoulder.
He quickly disappeared among the people.
Namgungwol and Juseolpung looked at the back of Yonghasang with a sad expression.
“How can this happen…”
“Ha ha!”
Meanwhile, the dragon had completely disappeared.
It was then.
“Lee Geomhan!”
“Lee Geom-han, the lord of Union Reunion!”
“Wow!”
Suddenly, the warlords chanted Lee Geom-han’s name.
I don’t know who started it first, but soon everyone shouted Lee Geom-han.
In particular, the warriors of the Unryeonhoe, who were greeted by a new lord, cheered more enthusiastically.
It was the birth of a new hero.
“Awesome!”
Pyowol looked at Namgungseol, who was hiding among the people.
I knew that she was the one who planned and carried out all of this.
The difference between Yong Ha-sang and Lee Geom-han was the presence or absence of Namgungseol.
Yong Ha-sang did not have a bookkeeper like her, and Namgung Seol, who was devoted to Lee Geom-han, existed.
The difference led to this result.
Perhaps Lee Geom-han will be able to lead the Union Association without difficulty in the future.
“In the end, it turned out to be a confrontation between Jang Mu-geuk and Lee Geom-han.”
They were two people who had been compared to each other ever since they were born.
The two eventually took control of the Geumcheonhoe and Eunryeonhoe, aiming for each other’s lives.
In a way, I didn’t know that it was a fate that had been decided for a long time.
It was for the same reason that the warlords cheered.
The fact that you can directly watch and participate in the fight of fate is to feel joy in itself.
“Do-gwang Lee Geom-han!”
“Lee Geom-han, the lord of Union Reunion.”
The shouts of the warlords grew louder as time went on.
It was truly a crucible of enthusiasm.
Then someone quietly hugged Pyowol’s arm.
Hong Ye-seol was the woman who pressed her breasts closely to Pyo-wol’s arms.
Hong Ye-seol whispered.
“It is time to leave. I don’t know what she will do if she stays longer.”
“hmm!”
Pyowol nodded.
Now, this place has become Namgungseol’s bedroom.
Namgungwol is still holding out, but soon Namgungseol will invade and take over his territory.
Namgungwol could never be planted by Namgungseol.
I could tell just by looking at Lee Geom-han’s control over people’s hearts.
Pyowol looked at Lee Geomhan for the last time.
Lee Geomhan was also looking straight ahead to see if he had found the Pyowol.
A smile hung on his face that he couldn’t hide.
It was a smile that only those who reached the pinnacle of a power could have.
His voice reached Pyowol’s ears.
– I’ll formally invite you later.

Normally, I wouldn’t even feel drunk no matter how much I drank. As soon as it entered the body, it would have been detoxified in an instant by the powerful inner energy.
But now it was different.
In addition to having received not a few internal injuries, his mind was dizzy and his inner strength was fluctuating wildly.

A man who had emptied a bottle of alcohol in an instant threw the jar.
Limp!

“Shit! Damn it!”
The man looked up at the sky and screamed.
After vomiting out all the air in his lungs, the man huffed and breathed for a while.
He lifted his head and brushed his messy hair.
The man staring straight ahead with bloodshot eyes was Yong Ha-sang.
Yong Ha-sang, who was defeated by Lee Geom-han, did not immediately return to Yongcheon Valley.
Returning to Yongcheongok like this, I had no face to see my father, and most of all, I had no confidence to see other people.
He was a dragon with stronger pride than anyone else and never experienced failure.
He didn’t know how to pull himself together and get up when he was defeated like this.
That’s why he didn’t go back to Yongcheongok right away and found a place where there were no people and drank alone.
The spirits of alcohol rose uncontrollably.
The stronger his drunkenness, the stronger his anger toward Lee Geom-han and Eun-ryeonhoe.
“How did I raise Eunryeonhoe and throw it away like a straw just because I lost just once? These filthy things.”
bang!
He hit the rock in front of him with his fist. Then the huge boulder shattered and fragments flew in all directions.
Even after breaking a rock the size of a house, his anger was not relieved.
“Aaaaaaa!”
He groaned and swung his fists at random.
A beautiful tree was cut down and rocks were shattered by Yongha-sang’s punches. The whole area was completely destroyed as if a thunderclap had exploded.
“ha! ha!”
Yonghasang, who had relieved his anger, let out a rough breath.
My stomach was stabbed when I went on a rampage while my internal injuries had not yet been fully healed. My wounds will be healed again.
Yong Ha-sang still thought it didn’t matter.
Anyway, I had to return to Yongcheon Valley in the form of a defeated soldier. It was enough to treat internal injuries during the journey to Yongcheongok.
“okay! have to go back After all, Yongcheongok is my home.”
The dragon had gnashed his teeth.
He walked away in anger.
Even when he came to Lake Poyang, there were many people following him, but the fact that he was alone when he returned made him even more miserable.
“Wait and see. I don’t fall apart like this As soon as I return to Yongcheongok, I will practice in the closed hall. I will surely take revenge by celebrating the feast of Yongcheongok.”
In Yongcheongok, there were numerous seasonal ceremonies that he hadn’t mastered yet.
In the meantime, I didn’t feel the need to learn it, but now I’ve changed my mind.
The desire to learn all martial arts and achieve greatness to take revenge has settled in his heart.
Yong Ha-sang moved to the riverside.
When I came here, the small boat I was on was tied to the river.
The appearance of the boat, which was small enough to accommodate only one person, looked as shabby as his own now.
It was when Yong Ha-sang shook his head and approached the ship.
Wow!
Suddenly, the calm waters roared violently.
Yong Ha-sang frowned and looked upstream where the current was rushing.
“ship?”
Where his gaze was directed, there was a huge ship.
The ship was so huge that it was almost as if a small island was moving. The calm waters were agitated as the current pushed downstream by the movement of the boat.
The huge ship was approaching exactly where the dragon river statue was.

chapters.title: Chapter 551
chapters.content:
Episode 551
The ripple caused by the death of Yong Ha-sang in Kang-ho was truly enormous.
Not only the Eunryeonhoe, but also the Geumcheonhoe, there was an uproar.
Even though he was defeated by Lee Geom-han and withdrew, he had been leading the Eunryeonhoe quite well until then.
Of course, after ascending to the position of Hoeju, he bought complaints from those around him to consolidate his power rather than fight against Geumcheonhoe, but he did nothing particularly wrong.
Because of that, the warriors of the Union Association did not have any ill feelings towards Yong Ha-sang.
Moreover, there were still many warriors who followed him in the union association.
They were enraged at the death of Yong Ha-sang and declared revenge.
When this happened, the place where I was embarrassed was the Geumcheonhoe.
It was because the pleural effusion looked like a golden blood. However, Geumcheonhoe did not move the troops and even more did not kill Yonghasang.
Even so, everyone in the world pointed to Geumcheonhoe as the beast that killed Yong Ha-sang.
If Yong Ha-sang had died while he was the owner of Union Union, it wouldn’t have been a problem.
In any case, the two forces were in a fierce war.
Timing was an issue.
Yong Ha-sang withdrew from the eunryeonhoeju and became a barbarian.
No matter how important Kang Ho’s favor is, it is against morality to immediately attack and kill a soldier who is about to become a wild man and return home.
Some people said that it was a problem to kill an opponent during the Gangho War, but the public sentiment of Kangho was not that simple.
Even if he killed a big man like Yong Ha-sang, he needed a justification for him to remain unscathed.
Knowing that fact, Geumcheonhoe couldn’t help but be embarrassed by Yong Ha-sang’s death.
It was because I felt that public sentiment was rapidly deteriorating.
Zhang Mu-geuk, head of the Jincheonhui, immediately summoned the leaders.
“What kind of people did this? Didn’t the warriors of the plenary really kill the dragon?”
“Fix it.”
It was Jang Ho-yeon, the owner of the Ugeom Lodge, who spoke in a low voice.
“Have I calmed down now? In any fight, the cause is important, but because of Yong Ha-sang’s death, public sentiment has shifted to that side.”
“It’s enough to turn the public’s mind around.”
“How?”
“People’s memories have limits, and public sentiment is inherently heartless. If we are given a little time, the slanted public sentiment can be quickly reversed. The important thing now is not to worry about public opinion, but to find out who killed the dragon.”
“hmm!”
Jang Ho-yeon’s quiet voice had the power to calm people down.
Jang Moo-geuk’s expression became more calm.
“You are right. I was so excited.”
He honestly admitted his mistake.
Jang Ho-yeon admired the appearance of Jang Mu-geuk.
It is because it is not so easy for a person in a high position like Zhang Wuji to honestly admit his mistakes.
Jang Moo-geuk asked Jang Ho-yeon.
“Then what can I do?”
“First of all, we have to find out the real beast. If we can only find out the evil beast, we will be able to use it to our advantage as well as to divert public sentiment.”
“Way?”
“If you look from the bottom up, something will come out. There are people like that among the people I know. Very useful for this kind of work.”
“Is there such a person?”
“After coming here, I have received quite a lot of help. If so, he will surely come to ask for information about the bottom.”
“Then I leave this task to you.”
Zhang Wuji smiled.
Dokgo Hwang, his most trusted friend, was out to avenge Eom Soso.
It was Jang Ho-yeon who filled his absence.
Jang Ho-yeon stood up from her seat and said.
“It will be resolved soon.”
“hmm!”
Jang Ho-yeon immediately left Daejeon and headed for some place.
It was a small attached building on one side of Geumcheonhoe.
It was in a corner so that people could not see it.
When I opened the door and entered, I saw a group of people sitting here and there.
Even at a glance, they were very messy and didn’t seem to fit in with the Geumcheonhoe. In fact, their ranks are very low.
When Jang Ho-yeon appeared, they stood up vigorously.
“Ouch! Who is this? Why did Confucius Zhang come to this shabby place?”
The man who approached Jang Mu-geuk with a flirtatious appearance was Deung Cheol-woong, the Ark of Blood.
Deung Cheol-woong’s expression when he looked at Jang Ho-yeon was not very good.
This is because Jang Ho-yeon and Geum Cheon-hoe have been neglected until now despite being the first-class contributors who made a contribution to settling down in Poyang Lake.
Because of that, his feelings toward Jang Ho-yeon were not so good.
Jang Ho-yeon looked at Deung Cheol-woong with cold eyes.
Deung Cheol-woong secretly turned his head to avoid his gaze.
‘Sir! I’m going to stare at you again.’
No matter how great he was, he couldn’t fight against Jang Ho-yeon.
Even if Jang Ho-yeon lifted a finger, he was dead.
Hoyeon Jang opened her mouth.
“I have a favor to ask you.”
“Are you… please?”
“Yes. please.”
“What is your request?”
Deung Cheol-woong’s expression softened slightly at the word “Please”.
In fact, it was no different from a command, but it was good to hear.
“I need information going around at the bottom.”
“Is this information?”
“okay! We need to find out who killed the dragon.”
“Isn’t that what you did at the Geumcheonhoe?”
“Be careful with your words.”
“You mean no?”
“Otherwise, I wouldn’t have given this order.”
“Hmm!”
Deung Cheol-woong made an interesting expression.
“If you do this right, I’ll give you the authority to manage all the supplies coming into the Golden Circle. That’s enough, no one in Poyang Lake will be able to ignore you.”
“Is that true?”
“I promise on my honor.”
“great.”
Only then did Deung Cheol-woong smile with satisfaction.
It was because Jang Ho-yeon, who had almost neglected himself and the blood room, knew that he would always keep the promise he made with his mouth.
The material coming into the Geumcheonhoe was truly enormous.
Even if you operate it for just one year, you will be able to reap huge profits compared to the gains gained from running the blood room for ten years.
That was enough.
The foundation of Poyangho, which was owned by the blood room, was still alive.
“Hehe! Please wait a bit. I will bring you good news soon.”
“Don’t expect it.”
＊＊＊
Yong Ha-sang’s body was placed in a stone coffin.
The sarcophagus contained ice crystals to keep the temperature cool.
It was a measure to preserve the body of Yong Ha-sang intact.
Thanks to this, Yong Ha-sang’s body remained intact and uncorrupted even after several days of death.
Namgungwol looked at the sarcophagus containing Yong Ha-sang’s body in silence. A look of sorrow was evident on his face.
It was because Yong Ha-sang’s death seemed to be his responsibility.
Namgung Seol stood beside Namgungwol.
Namgungseol looked at Namgungwol without a word.
“Whew!”
After a long time passed, Namgungwol sighed and looked at Namgungseol.
“thank you! For listening to an unreasonable request. Thanks to you, I was able to say goodbye.”
“It’s not such a difficult request.”
“I really didn’t know that this friend would die in vain.”
“What are you going to do now?”
“I have to go.”
“Without finding the beast that killed Confucius the Dragon? It would be faster to find the beast if you stay at the union association.”
“Your sister, just like your sister, find the beast. I will find my own way.”
“You mean you don’t want to be together until the end. good! I will not hold on to you any longer.”
Namgungseol’s expression turned cold.
Her heart was broken by her younger brother who pushed her to the end.
Namgungwol asked as if he had suddenly remembered.
“What are you going to do with the dead body?”
“I sent a letter to Yongcheongok. An answer will come sooner or later.”
It was more than 4,000 li from Poyang Lake, where Eunryeonhoe was located, to Yongcheon Valley.
No matter how fast the letter was sent, it took nearly 15 days to reach Yongcheongok.
Still in Yongcheongok, people would not even know the news that Yonghasang had died.
I was already worried about how Yongcheongok would react when he learned of the death of his only heir.
Yongcheongokju Yonggeomsan was a chauvinistic warrior to the extent that he was nicknamed Cheolpae-ryong (鐵覇龍).
As the owner of Yongcheongok, one of the three trophies, his martial arts was also ranked among the top ten in the world.
No one knew what such a great master would do if he got angry.
If Yonggeomsan were to intervene in the Gangho War, Cheonmujang or Gwangmumun would not be able to pretend to be on the sidelines like they did before.
If they all participate in the war, a tremendous tragedy will occur that cannot be compared to the strong wars so far.
The best thing was that Yongcheongok was just silently mourning the death of Yongha-sang, but everyone knew that it couldn’t end just like that.
Namgungwol said as he moved his steps.
“I’m really going this time! Bye.”
“Whoa!”
Namgungseol sighed instead of answering.
I couldn’t hold on to Namgungwol any longer.
There is nothing more foolish than holding on to someone whose heart has long since passed away.
Namgungwol left behind Namgungseol and left the Union Association.
Arriving at the dock, he boarded the boat without looking back.
The boat he was carrying quickly moved away from the dock.
Namgungwol let out a light sigh when the union meeting was no longer visible.
“Whoa!”
The past few days have been like a nightmare for him.
Just as he was about to leave the union association, Yong Ha-sang’s body was found, and he suffered greatly because of it.
It seemed as if Yong Ha-sang died because of him.
He thought that if he had trusted him to the end, things might have been different.
Such thoughts constantly haunted him. So, I haven’t slept a single moment in the past few days.
Because of that, his eyes were now bloodshot red.
In my mind, I wanted to go to a quiet place and sleep without a problem.
Namgungwol held back his desire and looked ahead.
The small boat carrying him crossed the Poyang Lake, wading through the calm waters.
the rower asked.
“Can we go on like this?”
“Yes. Just like this, go to the upper reaches of the Yangtze River. I’ll take care of getting off.”
“All right.”
The boatman rowed hard even though he had a puzzled look on his face.
Although the boat was small enough to carry only a couple of people, it crossed Lake Poyang at great speed.
It was possible because he was a boatman who had lived his entire life on a boat.
After a full day’s travel, the boat arrived at the junction of the Yangtze River.
In the meantime, Namgungwol curled up on the bow and dozed off.
Said the sailor carefully.
“Big deal! It is now the point of confluence with the Yangtze River.”
“huh?”
Namgungwol rubbed his eyes and looked around.
As the boatman said, it was the point where the Yangtze River joined Poyang Lake.
It was a place where the water flow was very strong. It was impossible to go back to this place on a small boat.
“Give me a boat over there.”
Namgungwol pointed to the riverside and said.
The boatman rowed hard and approached the riverside.
The current was so strong that the boatman’s body was drenched in sweat.
Namgungwol handed the boatman five hermits.
“Good job.”
“Ouch! You give me so much.”
“Then please return safely.”
Namgungwol kicked the boat and threw himself into the river.
It flew almost five feet and landed on the sandy beach.
“wow!”
The boatman exclaimed in exclamation at Namgungwol’s movements.
While I was at Poyang Lake, I saw quite a few warriors, but none of them performed as wonderful martial arts as Namgungwol. But the admiration was short-lived.
The boatman quickly turned the boat around and returned to where it came from.
Namgungwol looked at the boat as it moved away for a while and then performed light maneuvers. Even so, his physical condition wasn’t too bad because he slept on the boat.
The reason why Namgungwol dared to get off the ship and perform the light maneuver is because he did not want Namgungseol or others to know his destination.
It was clear that Namgungseol would try to find out his destination by wiping out the boatman.
Knowing the propensity of Namgungseol, Namgungwol went to great lengths to perform Gyeonggong himself.
After running for a while, I came out of the forest and saw an open view.
It was on a cliff overlooking the Yangtze River.
At the end of the cliff was a large manor.
On the signboard of the manor, three characters were written: Solgawon (乺家院).

thump thump!

The skin was tingling.
Because I felt someone’s gaze.
It was such a secretive gaze that only masters who reached the level of Namgungwol could not feel it.
‘As expected, the assassins are hiding.’
At first glance, the manor looked empty, but in fact, it was the most dangerous place in the world with assassins all over the place.
In fact, there weren’t that many assassins left in Solgawon. Most of the assassins collected by Pyowol so far left for some place for training, and only a few of Salno and Tenhyeolsal remained.
Nevertheless, it is felt as the most dangerous fortress in the world because the ability of those who remain is outstanding.
Namgungwol swallowed dry saliva and walked inside.
The battle that Salno guided was very dark.
It was because the people staying here were all assassins, so there was no need for light.
Assassins basically learn to see things in the dark. Even in dim light, they maximized their eyesight so they could see as if it were daylight.
Because of that, there was only minimal light in Solgawon.
Salno stopped in front of the door at the innermost part of Daejeon.
“Dear Jizon. A guest has arrived.”
“Come in together.”
“yes!”
Salno answered and opened the door.
I saw Pyowol sitting on the bed.
Behind Pyowol who was taking off her top, I could see Hong Ye-seol covering her upper body with a blanket.
Even though the two entered, Hong Ye-seol was smiling as if he was not ashamed.
“Mmm!”
Namgungwol’s face turned red.
He couldn’t bear to look at Hong Ye-seol and turned his head.
“Long time no see.”
Pyo-wol stood up and approached him with his shirt off.
“yes! Long time no see.”
“How did you come to Union Reunion?”
“Long, so to speak.”
“Sit down. Let’s talk over tea.”
Pyowol sat down at the table.
As Namgungwol sat across from him, Salno naturally started brewing tea.
It was very natural to put a kettle with water on the brazier and prepare the tea leaves.
Salno quickly got out of the car and put it in front of the two of them.
“Now tell me. What happened?”
“That’s…”
Namgoongwol looked at Salno and Hong Ye-seol with a blurry end.
Hong Ye-seol smiled without a hint of shame, and Pyo-wol continued to speak calmly.
“These are people you can trust. It doesn’t matter if you listen together.”
At Pyowol’s words, Namgungwol nodded and opened his mouth.
“The dragon has died.”
“…”
Pyowol’s expression hardened.
Because it was an event that he had not anticipated.
“A few days ago, a boat carrying his body was found at the dock in front of Eunryeonhoe.”
“Are you sure it’s a dragon statue?”
“I found and confirmed. The dragon is clear.”
“What about the pleural effusion?”
“I haven’t figured it out yet.”
“The cause of death?”
“It is a penetrating wound in the chest. Judging from the size and shape, it appears that something like a spear or rod has penetrated it.”
Pyowol closed her eyes.
It was because there was a rising existence.
Even at that moment, Namgungwol’s words continued.
“Right now, the Geumcheonhoe and Eunryeonhoe are upset because of that.”
“What do you say at the Geumcheonhoe?”
“They are protesting that they didn’t kill them.”
“The Eunryeonhoe must be talking about attacking the Geumcheonhoe right now.”
“Exactly. Namgung…Seol will never miss this opportunity.”
“I guess so. I got a justification, so of course I should use it.”
“I’m worried about how Yongcheongok will come out there. If Yonggeomsan, who lost his one and only heir, comes here with the elites of Yongcheongok, the problem will become even more serious. Perhaps the upheaval so far cannot be called tribulation.”
“If Yongcheongok moves, Cheonmujang or Gwangmumun will move too.”
At Pyowol’s words, Namgungwol nodded.
“yes! If that happens, Shaolin Shaman Volcano will no longer be able to stand by.”
“In a true sense, a cataclysm will occur.”
“The frontline, which was limited to Poyang Lake, will expand to the entire world. A more serious problem is that there is no clear distinction between friends and vassals like in the previous strong-and-strong war.”
For more than two hundred years, Jianghu has experienced two world wars.
The first World War was a fight between all the powerful and the Demonic Cult, and the second World War was a battle between the whole strong and powerful.
In both World Wars, the enemy was clear.
The target to fight was clear, so all I had to do was fight with all my might. But now it was different.
As a proxy war, it was divided into the Geumcheonhoe and Eunyeonhoe, fighting, but numerous Eunwon relationships were intertwined like a spider’s web.
Depending on the Eunwon, it was difficult to even distinguish who was the enemy and who was the ally.
No one in Gangho had ever experienced a fight like this. So, I couldn’t even predict how the fight would turn out.
If even a huge clan like Yongcheongok joins in, other clans related to them will not be able to stand still.
“Maybe we will suffer more damage than the previous two world wars.”
“Isn’t that overexaggerating?”
“no. This is also minimally predictable. If my predictions are correct, the world of Kang Ho may walk the path of destruction.”
“The destruction of Kangho…”
A deep gap opened between Pyowol’s forehead.
Because it was something I had never thought of before.
Pyowol looked at Namgungwol.
Namgungwol had an expression that showed no doubt in his thoughts.
Pyowol murmured.
“I don’t think it would be bad even if Gangho perished.”
“Why do you think so?”
“I thought that was the right thing to do.”
“yes?”
“So you think this is normal? That only a few special people have great power and control the fate of others?”
“That’s…”
“Excess of anything is as bad as not enough.”
“Have you become a wise man? Why do you say things that do not fit?”
“Because I lead a group, I think a lot.”
When I was promoting alone, I didn’t think about it this deeply. However, as I unified my life, I began to think a lot.
Like it or not, it was because he had to lead those who reaped it well.
It was something that couldn’t be left to Salno alone.
The best of Salmun was himself.
In the end, it was he himself who had to set the big frame and present the direction in which he should move.
Because of that, I had to think a lot when I was alone.
The more I thought about it, the more I thought that the world of Kang Ho was abnormal.
In a world where most of the ordinary people are, he doubted whether it was natural for Kangho to exist.
Currently, Kang-ho was in the prime of his career.
Since the beginning of Gangho, there had never been so many literary factions. But the higher the mountain, the deeper the valley.
Right now, he is enjoying his prime. If an incident led to a head start, I couldn’t even guess where the bottom was.
Namgungwol looked at Pyowol with a strange expression and continued.
“I don’t know if the strongholds will really perish, but if the Great War of the World becomes a reality, they will not be able to avoid their downfall.”
“so?”
“It should be stopped.”
“how?”
“I wonder if it will be possible if Pyo Daehyup helps.”
“Should I? It is said that they have gathered the power of salmun as one, but the reality is that none of the three jangs in Leegang and Sampae can handle it.”
“But…”
“There’s nothing we can do right now. For now, I have no choice but to watch…”
Namgungwol bit his lip at Pyowol’s heartless words.
In my head, I knew that Pyowol’s words were correct. But psychologically, it was difficult to accept.
“Whew!”
Namgungwol let out a deep sigh.
The drooping shoulders made him look very pitiful.
Namgungwol realized that he could not convince Pyowol with words. However, he could not force Pyowol to threaten him.
Pyo-wol crossed his arms and looked at Namgung-wol.
“Why do you waste your energy on useless things?”
“yes?”
“No matter how close you are, I am strangers to you. In the end, I have no choice but to put my own interests first.”
“But…”
“Rather than persuading me, move thousands of times.”
“But thousands of times…”
“Is it because it came out on my own, so I am going back now? For pride?”
“….”
“Is pride that important? If you really want to get what you want, can’t you kill your pride? I’m like…”
Jurreuuk!
In an instant, Namgungwol’s lips were squeezed and blood flowed out.
You have bitten your teeth too hard and your gums have ruptured.
“If you really want to stop a cataclysm, move thousands of times.”
“But how?”
“You have to figure it out. Either persuade your father and brother or subdue them by force. You know how.”
“….”
“Don’t force others to sacrifice if you don’t have the courage to do so.”
Pyowol’s words became daggers and pierced Namgungwol’s chest mercilessly.
My heart ached.
I couldn’t breathe properly.
Namgoongwol lowered his head.
Pyowol didn’t say anything more.
He had already pushed Namgungwol to the edge of the cliff. If you press more than this, you may fall and never regain your confidence.
Hong Ye-seol and Salno looked at Namgung-wol with interesting expressions.
Namgungwol must have thought a lot before coming here. His intention was to somehow move the Pyowol to prevent a cataclysmic upheaval.
I understood how righteous he was. However, understanding and moving according to his intentions were two different things. And the pyowol they knew was a person who extremely hated being used by others.
That’s why I expected that Pyo-wol would not listen to Namgung-wol, but I really didn’t know that he would push Namgung-wol this far without mercy.
Time passed in everyone’s silence.
“Whoa!”
Finally, Namgungwol let out a deep sigh and rose from his seat.
His eyes were deeper than before.
I thought that if I had attained enlightenment in an instant, I would have the same eyes as Namgungwol now.
In the midst of the conflict, it was clear that something had been firmly established.
Namgungwol said.
“I was foolish. In the first place, I should have gone to the Pyo Daehyeop instead of visiting it thousands of times.”
“….”
“I will go thousands of times even now.”
“If you do it wrong, you could become enemies with your parents and siblings.”
“I have already become enemies with my older sister. I don’t think it will change much if a father and an older brother are added to it.”
Namgungwol’s gaze was that of a person who was determined.
Namgungwol until now did not exist anymore.
That night, Namgungwol immediately left Solgawon and headed for thousands of times.

chapters.title: Chapter 553
chapters.content:
Episode 553 Dragon
Sword Mountain’s chin twitched.
The leaders of Yongcheongok all bowed their heads.
Their faces were full of sorrowful light.
In Yonggeomsan’s hand was a crumpled letter.
He opened the letter again and read it.
“Hasang is dead? The successor who will lead Yongcheongok died a violent death? Are you telling me to believe this?”
He had received a letter from his son saying that he was doing well just 15 days ago. But now he had a letter in his hand telling him that his son had died.
Kwajik!
Yonggeomsan couldn’t stand it and crumpled the letter again.
His eyes were already bloodshot red.
The whole body of Yonggeomsan was freed like a skein of life and put pressure on the leadership.
The faces of the leaders turned white.
“Fix it, please.”
“God master!”
The leaders begged Yonggeomsan.
Only then did the dragon sword mountain slowly take in the murderous spirit it emitted.
Yonggeomsan looked at the leaders and said.
“Is this true? Isn’t that the wrong letter?”
“As a result of the confirmation, it is correct that it flew from the union association.”
“Does that mean my son is really dead? The son of this Dragon Sword Mountain.”
“I apologize.”
“can not believe it. I’ll have to see it with my own eyes. Summon the best of the original song right away.”
“I take orders.”
The leaders responded in unison.
There are over a thousand elite troops in Yongcheongok alone.
If that amount of troops enter the stronghold, there will be an uproar.
It was clear that clans like Cheonmujang or Gwangmumun Shaolin Temple would check it right away. For that reason, Yongcheongok was extremely careful not to send out more than a certain amount of troops.
Yonggeomsan had a chauvinistic tendency to the extent that it was called Iron Pae-ryong (鐵覇龍), but he did not make the mistake of acting recklessly, believing only in strength.
Knowing that one hand cannot block ten hands, I have extremely refrained from advancing into the strong game. However, she could not maintain her reason in the face of her son’s death.
He denied his son’s death with his mouth, but his head was thinking that the contents of the letter might be true.
“If my son is really dead, I will kill everyone involved with him.”
After his death, the great battle shook as if it would collapse at any moment.
“Keugh!”
“omg!”
The leaders of Yongcheongok also possessed strong martial arts, but they could not withstand the furious lion’s roar of Yonggeomsan Mountain.
The Lion’s Roar of Yonggeomsan continued for a long time after that.
＊＊＊
A group of people gathered in a deserted house in the mountains.
In the abandoned house, where people left long ago, only the walls remained, barely blocking the wind.
Those gathered in the abandoned house kept warm by lighting a bonfire in the center.
In the center of the group sat a man with exceptionally dark hair and thick eyebrows.
Dokgo Hwang was the man warming himself by the bonfire, wearing a blood jacket made of fish leather.
Those who were surrounded by Dokgohwang were the elites of martial arts training.
There were dozens of people gathered, but no one spoke. Dokgo Hwang didn’t open his mouth, so everyone kept silent.
Dokgohwang looked at the blazing bonfire with his mouth tightly shut.
The brightly burning light cast a dark shadow on his face.
Suddenly he opened his mouth.
“Soso!”
She was the woman who was always by my side.
A woman who only looked at her and lived for him.
I didn’t feel it when we were together, but now that I thought she was gone, a huge sense of loss came over me, like a hole in one side of my chest.
I just realized
How much of a weight did she have on him?
Umsoso no longer exists in the world.
The moon had taken her away from him.
Awesome!
Dokgohwang gnashed his teeth.
His men held their breath in anger.
No one dared to open their mouth and only looked at Dokgo Hwang.
It was then.
Tadadak!
Someone from outside lunged inside.
It was an unmanned man who appeared to be in his mid-thirties.
The warrior immediately knelt down in front of Dokgo Hwang.
“I found his traces.”
“Really?”
Dokgohwang jumped up.
“yes!”
“Where did you find it?”
“It seems that he is hiding in a place not too far from Poyang Lake.”
“Tell me in detail.”
“This is a fact I found out while monitoring Namgoongwol of the Union Association.”
“Namgungwol?”
“yes! It is a special relationship with Pyowol. I was keeping a close eye on him after leaving the Union Association this time, but he left Poyang Lake and went to the upper reaches of the Yangtze River. So I tracked it down.”
“result?”
“I missed it. He suddenly disappeared in the forest upstream…”
“So?”
The eyes of Dokgo Hwang, who questioned him, were swaying with life. Even so, the reporting subordinate’s complexion was calm.
It was proof of his confidence.
he continued.
“After a full day, it came out of the woods again.”
“So you must have been in contact with Pyowol during the day you disappeared?”
“That’s right.”
“You wouldn’t guess that Pyowol would be there simply because of that, would you?”
“It is information that there is a manor called Solgawon in the forest where Namgungwol disappeared.”
“Solgawon?”
“yes! It seems like an ordinary manor name, but in fact it is one of the salmun.”
“Selling?”
“Recently, rumors have been circulating that he has been living a life. If so, it is highly likely that you have made one of the salmuns your base.”
“That makes sense.”
Dokgohwang shook his head.
For the past few days, there has been nothing I haven’t done to find Pyowol. Even so, Pyowol was so new and rare that I hadn’t met him yet.
“What is the exact location of Solgawon?”
“I only found out that it was in the forest, but I don’t know the exact location.”
“We must surround and search the entire forest.”
“I think it’s worth a try.”
“How many people can move now?”
“About seven hundred people.”
“That is not enough.”
“Why don’t you ask for help from the Geumcheonhoe?”
Subha cautiously expressed his opinion.
Dokgo Hwang shook his head after thinking for a moment.
“No, I will not inform the Geumcheonhoe. I don’t want to put more pressure on Mu-geuk, who has a lot to do even if he doesn’t.”
“All right.”
“We do this by ourselves. Get everything ready.”
“yes! I will.”
Subha stood up with an answer.
Dokgohwang looked around at the other subordinates and said.
“Now the break is over. From now on we will hunt the reaper. He is cunning and cruel. Even if you’re not paying attention, his blade will pierce your neck. Never neglect your vigilance. Do you understand?”
“yes!”
The subordinates answered in unison.
Dokgohwang swung his sleeves wildly. Then the burning bonfire was extinguished at once.
Dokgohwang muttered as he left the abandoned house.
“Pyowol! I will grind your bones and drink them.”
＊＊＊
Pyowol left the main gate of Solgawon and walked to the edge of the cliff.
I could see the Yangtze River flowing under the sheer cliffs.
There were many boats on the Yangtze River.
Most of them were small fishing boats, but there were also quite large boats among them.
They were ships that transported cargo, such as Unma riverboats and rice carriers.
Pyo-wol muttered after looking at the ship for a long time.
“You mean the dragon is dead?”
From the time Namgoongwol told him about Yong Ha-sang’s cause of death, a person’s face appeared in Pyo-wol’s mind.
“Go Il-won.”
Except for Jang Moo-geuk, the owner of Geumcheonhoe, the only warrior who could kill Yong Ha-sang was Go Il-won. Lee Geom-han was possible, but there was no reason to kill Yong Ha-sang to cause confusion.
When he first met Ko Il-won, he shot a harpoon at Pyo-wol several hundred times apart.
If Pyowol’s martial arts were weak or his reaction speed was insufficient, the harpoon would have pierced his chest.
That’s why as soon as I heard the piercing wound in Yong Ha-sang’s chest, I thought of Ko Il-won.
“Are you targeting me and doing this?”
Ko Il-Won’s ultimate goal must be himself. But the method was a problem. Instead of attacking himself directly, he chose to turn the world into hell using strong battles.
It was a vicious mental world beyond imagination.
Even so, Pyowol was not at all surprised or thought it was strange.
This is because the identity of the existence of Guryongsalmak was the same as that of Go Il-won.
They never come to the fore.
They completely hide their appearance and create chaos, only taking advantage of it.
In this way, they have created confusion in the dark and made huge profits.
Although Makju and Roh Tae-tae of Guryongsalmak died at the hands of Pyo-wol, their strength was maintained intact.
Many of the remaining power was taken by Soyeowol, and Ko Ilwon completely took control of the core ghost fleet.
Although the faction was divided into two, the basic tendency did not change.
It was the same with Go Il-won.
Even though they possess the mighty power of the ghost fleet, they do not come to the fore.
They were only looking for the best opportunity to hunt after encouraging confusion in the river.
Pyowol’s gaze was fixed on the flowing Yangtze River.
‘It means he’s hiding somewhere in the Yangtze River.’
Pyowol’s eyes narrowed.
The ships of the Ghost Fleet were basically very large.
It was impossible for such huge ships to go unnoticed.
‘There must be a hiding place that is not noticed by people.’
There must be a heavenly port somewhere on the Yangtze River that is invisible even when several ships are anchored there.
In order to catch Go Won-il, he had to find their hiding place first.
Then, from behind, there was a soft hand hugging Pyowol’s neck.
The owner of the snow-white hands was Hong Ye-seol.
she whispered.
“What do you think?”
“The one who killed the dragon.”
“Do you know someone?”
“I have met you once.”
“Does he have a grudge against you?”
“I killed his family.”
“You deserve a grudge.”
Hong Ye-seol said calmly.
The karma of being an assassin had no choice but to inevitably incur the grudge of others.
It was rather strange to profit from killing someone’s family and acquaintances, and not to be accompanied by resentment.
“Are you dangerous? If you think about it this deeply.”
“It has powerful martial arts that are strong enough to kill the Dragon King and strong forces that are second to none of the strong giants.”
“As expected, those who hold grudges are amazing, befitting the supreme master of life.”
Hong Ye-seol’s red lips drew an arc and went up.
As soon as Pyowol heard Pyowol’s words, even a moderately powerful woman would have lost strength in her legs and collapsed to the ground. However, Hong Ye-seol was not an ordinary woman.
She was a special being who rose to the peak of assassination with the body of a woman.
The pulpit was also different because he came out of the toughest chaos than anyone else. That’s why I didn’t feel intimidated or scared at all by Pyowol’s words.
Pyo-wol smiled and took Hong Ye-seol’s hand, which was wrapped around his neck.
It was then.
Roaring!
Suddenly, from the other side of the forest, there was a strong flash of light.
Pyo-wol and Hong Ye-seol looked at each other.
It was a fire that started from a distance, but I got the feeling that someone set it on fire targeting Solgawon.
It is not uncommon for such intense fire to occur spontaneously.
Moreover, this place was extremely sparsely populated.
There was no reason for that level of fire to rise unless someone intentionally set it on fire.
Pyowol murmured.
“It’s an assault.”
“Is he the one who killed the dragon?”
“It won’t be.”
“Do you have any reason to think so?”
“This is not his way.”
Exactly, it wasn’t the method of Guryongsalmak or Ghost Fleet.
They only show up when the opponent is cornered and no longer has the strength to resist.
The flames quickly spread throughout the forest and approached Solgawon.
Pyo-wol said to Hong Ye-seol.
“Summon all the remaining members of Solgawon.”
“yes!”

chapters.title: Chapter 554
chapters.content:
Episode 554
There weren’t many people left in Sol Family.
There were only Pyowol, Hongyeseol, Salno, 10 of the Brain’s Heuksaldae, and about 30 assassins from other groups of assassins.
The rest of the staff had all been sent to some place in advance for training. Thanks to that, Solgawon was quiet.
The fire was spreading very quickly.
At this rate, it was clear that he would reach Solgawon before half an hour passed.
At that time, the brain that went out to reconnaissance returned.
Noenan knelt down on one knee in front of the moon and reported.
“The enemy is herding outside the woods. They are burning the forest by throwing salt and oil phosphorus lamps on it.”
“What is it?”
“I couldn’t check because of the fire. sorry.”
If it had been a normal fire, it would have gone through. However, the fires burning the forest now were not ordinary. The firepower was raised to the peak by mixing salt, oil, phosphorus, etc. in a special combination.
Once the fire is attached to the body, it will never be extinguished until it is all consumed and reduced to ashes.
In my brain, I watched the sight of the wild boar on fire screaming and jumping into the pond, all burnt to ashes.
If it was a catalyst that caused such a fire, it had to be seen as more heinous than any other gold memorization.
It was impossible for ordinary people or forces to save such a heinous object.
It was one of the leading powers in the river, but it was something that could only be obtained by avoiding people’s eyes.
Hearing the explanation inside the brain, Pyowol’s expression hardened.
Pyowol looked at Salno.
“How to escape?”
“I have three places, but two are in the woods.”
“It will be useless.”
“yes! A fire like this would have burned all the escape routes.”
“What about the rest?”
“It’s going down the cliff.”
“Cliff?”
“yes! It’s dangerous, but if you have the skills of an assassin, you should be able to go down enough.”
Assassins basically learn martial arts like wall hogong.
It is not that difficult for them to go down the ceiling cliff. It just takes a long time.
The question is whether the people who set fire to this place will leave the ceiling cliff, the only escape route.
If Pyowol had planned an attack, he would have prepared for escape by deploying troops under the cliff.
Obviously, the people who set fire to this place would have done the same.
“It will be useless to go down the cliff.”
“yes! I will dig a trap and wait.”
Salno replied with a smile.
Hong Ye-seol and Noe-an nodded.
They did everything they could as an assassin.
Because of that, I could figure out their intentions just by looking at the situation going back.
There was no way that a person with a cruel mind and heart that burned down an entire huge forest would have left the only escape route.
Perhaps descending as the only escape route is what they want.
Above all, it did not suit their inclination to be frightened by the threat of unknown enemies and escape like this.
When retreating, even if they retreated, they had to figure out the identity of the enemies and feed them properly.
There was nothing more terrifying than being looked down on in a river.
You have to show that there is a hidden one and a proper one on this side, so you can’t do this provocation again.
Pyowol said.
“Then it’s decided. Everyone knows what to do, right?”
“yes!”
“of course.”
Salno Neongan replied in a confident voice.
Hong Ye-seol also responded with an eerie smile.
Pyowol said as he glared at the flames approaching Solgawon.
“Then let’s begin.”
＊＊＊
Dokgo Hwang watched the flames soar high into the sky with his arms crossed.
The flames spread with tremendous force, completely burning the outer edge of the forest and digging into the center.
The flames, greedily devouring everything like a living monster, were nothing out of the ordinary.
It was a monster made of salt vinegar, phosphorus oil, and white fire phosphorus, a special combination of several ingredients.
Once attached to a living creature, it will never be extinguished until it is reduced to ashes.
Because of its heinous power, it was something that had only been made and never used even in Mugeomryeon.
Even Dokgo Hwang didn’t bring Baekhwarin with the intention of using it. It was only brought on board the ship, just in case.
Dokgo Hwang hoped that Baekhwarin would never be used. However, in front of Eom So-so’s death, he lost his temper.
He ordered his subordinates to use Baekhwarin.
He intends to burn the entire forest and burn Pyowol and the assassins at the stake.
Of course, numerous troops were placed under the cliff, the only escape route.
Dokgohwang looked at the flames and murmured.
“So what are you going to do?”
His eyes radiated a light as hot as a blazing fire.
The sight was so terrifying that even the subordinates shuddered.
The warriors of Dokgohwang and Mugeomryeon advanced little by little along the flames.
Where the flames had passed, only black ash remained.
Above them, armed warriors passed by.
Bass Rock!
The ashes that were trodden on were shattered and scattered.
The martial arts fighters frowned at the pungent smell that stimulated their sense of smell. Just smelling it was enough to give me a headache.
But no one cried or anything.
It was about two o’clock that I had advanced along the flames.
“I see a manor over there.”
“Solgawon is right.”
The warrior who was advancing in the lead saw a huge manor over the flames and shouted.
It was too young to live in the eyes of Dokgo Hwang.
“He was hiding in a place like this.”
The fire had yet to reach Solgawon. However, after a while, it will devour all of Sol Gawon.
Dokgohwang shouted.
“Everyone be careful, they might come out at any moment.”
“yes!”
The martial arts warriors answered in unison.
Of the seven hundred people, five hundred are gathered here. The other two hundred were waiting at the foot of the cliff.
No matter how many assassins there were, it was impossible to break through them and get out of here.
The most efficient ones were those that burned completely so they didn’t have to use their hands. But again, that was not what Dokgo Hwang wanted.
“I will cut off your breath myself.”
Dokgohwang gritted his teeth.
His murderousness was so thick that even his henchmen did not dare to come close to him.
Whoa!
In his life, the flames in the front fluctuated greatly.
The roaring flames raged wildly, engulfing him. Still, Dokgohwang did not blink an eye.
Roaring!
The flames finally engulfed Solgawon.
All of the warriors of the Mugeomryun glared at Solgawon while holding their weapons.
If there were really assassins in that manor, it was clear that they would not be able to stand the flames and would come out.
They were fully prepared to attack at any time.
However, even though the flames completely engulfed Solgawon, not a single assassin came out.

Quaang!

Kwak Kwa Kwak!

teeting!

jjoong!

Jiju Silver Net (蜘蛛銀網).

“bloke!”

There was no reason to feel ashamed or guilty.
As I said, his essence was an assassin.
No matter how much fame he gains and is revered as one of the strongest in the gang, his essence does not change.
Dokgohwang widened his eyes and glared at Pyowol.

?
