In fact, Deung Cheol-woong thought his heart would sink.
The eight constellations that shine most brilliantly in the river.
Some of them died or were defeated by Pyo-wol, and their reputations were somewhat faded, but they were still top-notch warriors.
Although King Gujin was in the last seat of the Palseongjwa, that did not mean that his martial arts were the weakest among the Eight Constellations.
It was King Gujin who wandered around the river without joining any power for the rest of his life.
king of wolves.
He has acted arbitrarily all his life and fought so many times that he earned the nickname King Nangwang.
Yet he is still alive.
because it was that strong.
His rough temper and cruel hands were feared by everyone in Jianghu.
‘Shit! Of course, it’s a nangwang…’
Deung Cheol-woong thought it was a mistake.
I don’t know why the king was interested in me, but once I got caught in his hands, it was impossible to get out smoothly.
King Gu Jin asked.
“Did you say it was the Ark of the Chamber of Blood?”
“yes!”
“Isn’t it true that the blood room is an indigenous clan of Poyang Lake?”
“That’s right.”
“Hehe! If you do, you will understand the situation around Lake Poyang well.”
“yes!”
Deung Cheol-woong wondered what King Gu Jin was trying to say with such lengthy words.
King Gujin pointed to the two swords behind his back and said.
“These guys are called fear and gold. It is a famous sword that will not exist again in the world.”
“ah!”
“I’m looking for a sword of a similar level to this. I’d like to know if anyone in Lake Poyang owns such a sword.”

chapters.title: Chapter 557
chapters.content:
Episode 557
“Yes?”
Deung Cheol-woong thought he had heard it wrong.
It was because there was no way that a person with such a famous sword was common, and he couldn’t understand why he was asking himself about it.
As Deung Chul-woong seemed to be unable to understand what he was saying, an annoyed expression appeared on King Gu Jin’s face.
The moment he saw the change in his expression, Deung Cheol-woong felt his heart sink once again.
he said hastily.
“Oh no! I will tell you.”
“You mean you know someone with a sword of this level?”
“There is a place called the top of my jewon.”
“Jewon top?”
“yes! It is one of the leading guilds in the world, and the main body is located here at Poyang Lake. There are all sorts of valuable items in the warehouse at the top of Jewon, and among them are many of the best swords in the world.”
“Is that true?”
“I can bet on my neck.”
Deung Cheol-woong shouted loudly.
In fact, he couldn’t be sure if there was a famous sword in the report of the top of the data. However, Jewon Sangdan was the only place in Poyang Lake that had the financial strength and ability to keep it secretly.
Because they keep anything that makes money in the treasury.
It was because of resentment that Deung Cheol-woong said this even though he was not sure that there was a famous sword at the top of the memorial.
The reason why he, who lived like a king without any shame in Lake Poyang, fell down when he got involved with the Jewon Sangdan.
Roh Tae-tae sent his great-grandson, Ju Seol-pung, to persecute him and the blood room.
From then on, the blood room collapsed and became a life hidden in the shadows. The reason he entrusted himself to the Geumcheonhoe was to get revenge on the Jewon Sangdan and Ju Seol-pung. However, the Jewon Sangdan cut off the justification for others to intervene by cutting ties with Ju Seol-pung.
Because of that, neither Geumcheonhoe nor other strong factions could touch the top of the Jewon.
There had to be a justification to touch a gigantic guild like the Jewon corps.
No matter how much Deung Cheol-woong and others talked about the need to punish the Jewon Corps, he didn’t even snort.
Because of that, I hadn’t even dared to take revenge until now.
‘If I use this old man well, I’ll be able to give a big blow to the top of the jewon.’
Deung Cheol-woong secretly smiled maliciously.
It was a trick that came to mind in an instant under King Gujin’s pressure. But it was pretty good for what I recalled as an improvisation.
“Because it’s the jewon top… can you bet on your neck?”
“of course. However, it will never be easy to come out with a sword from the treasure trove.”
“What are you saying? Are you doubting my ability?”
“How could I doubt the trustworthiness of the king? What I’m worried about is that the Jewon Corps has deployed an enormous force in Bogo. Their wealth was so great that they employed many amazing warriors. It is very dangerous to break through the treasury they are guarding.”
“Hahaha!”
King Gu Jin suddenly burst into madness.
Quarre!
“Gagging!”
“evil!”
The inn was shaken violently by his madness, as if it would collapse at any moment, and the drinkers covered their ears and collapsed.
However, there was no blow to Deung Cheol-woong right in front of him.
gulp!
Deung Cheol-woong swallowed dry spit again.
Just by looking at this one number, it was possible to know what a transcendent master King Gu Jin was. It was because he was momentarily confused about whether his plan to use such a great master was right.
‘Maybe I was wrong…’ I regretted it
for a while, but it was a symbol anyway.
Once on the tiger’s back, you couldn’t get off in the middle.
‘Sir! I don’t know! it will work out somehow.’
If necessary, he could have used Jang Ho-yeon of Geumcheonhoe.
In the worst case, he could separate himself from King Gu Jin and leave only his body.
I was tired of being swayed by other people anymore.
‘good! My destiny is to be pioneered by me.’
Deung Cheol-woong ate his heart.
bang!
At that time, King Gujin hit the table with his big hand and stood up.
The thick table turned to dust in his days.
Deung Cheol-ung opened his eyes wide at the unbelievable sight.
‘oh my god!’
It was easy to break the table, but turning it into dust like that required unimaginable patience.
He knew that King Gu Jin’s martial arts was transcendent, but seeing it with his own eyes made his limbs tingle even more.
King Gu Jin looked at Deung Cheol-ung and said.
“Anyway, I have to show you my status in person. Please guide me to the top of the temple.”
“You mean now?”
“okay! Direct me there right now.”
“But…”
“If you hesitate once more, I’ll pull out your head and throw it away.”
“I see. I will guide you right away.”
King Gu Jin was a more crazy person than Deung Cheol-ung expected.
I knew it was arbitrary, but I really didn’t know it would be like this.
Deung Cheol-woong cautiously got up from his seat and walked out of the inn.
King Gujin followed him.
When I came out of the inn, I saw familiar faces.
These were the subordinates he had sent out to gather information.
Deung Cheol-woong’s subordinates made expressions of bewilderment at the unexpected situation. They noticed that the old man next to Deung Cheol-woong was an unusual master.
Otherwise, there was no way Deung Cheol-woong would behave like a mouse in front of a cat.
Deung Cheol-woong exchanged glances with his subordinates.
His subordinates were as quick-witted as Deung Cheol-ung.
They saw what was going on and knew they couldn’t step out.
Deung Cheol-woong nodded slightly.
It meant going to the Geumcheonhoe and reporting it.
Fortunately, his subordinates understood Deung Cheol-woong’s intentions and disappeared from the crowd.
At that time, King Gu Jin smiled and said.
“It seems they are your subordinates. Everyone resembles the owner and is quick-witted like a rat.”
“That’s…”
“I don’t want to hear your excuses, so hurry up and guide me to the report.”
“yes!”
Deung Cheol-woong also gave up making excuses and moved on.
“Big! Feel so good.”
King Gujin brought the wine bottle from the inn and put it in his mouth.
The burning sensation of bamboo leaf extract entering his esophagus made him even more excited.
Limp!
King Gujin muttered as he threw the empty wine bottle to the floor.
“Hehe! It’s a good drink.”
Deung Cheol-woong shook his head.
It was because King Gu Jin’s voice felt like a wolf’s roar.
It felt like a huge wolf would bite his neck at any moment. It was the first time I felt like this.
Deung Cheol-woong walked for a long time and finally arrived in front of the top of the memorial.
The top of the jewon was firmly locked on the huge front door. After the Gangho Daejeon took place, the Jewon Sangdan closed the door like this and strictly prohibited outside activities.
Unmanned access was completely banned and only other merchants and merchants were brought in.
It was an expression of his will to completely build a wall with Kang-ho.
Although Roh Tae-tae’s great-grandson, Ju Seol-pung, was involved in the Eunryeonhoe, he remained neutral. For that reason, the Geumcheonhoe did not put much pressure on the top of the jewon.
There were only two soldiers standing at the front gate of the jewon top.
It was a minimal guard force.
They were wary when strangers appeared.
“Who are you?”
“Stop and identify yourself.”
Despite their warnings, Deung Cheol-ung and Gu Jin-wang did not stop walking.
“I told you to stop.”
“Come on, reveal your identity.”
It was the moment when the unmanned people warned once again.
“Where do the flying flies keep talking?”
King Gujin waved his hands as if to drive away flies.
Puff!
At that moment, with a strong impact sound, the soldiers at the top of the jewon collapsed. He died without a moment to scream.
‘Ugh!’
In his formidable hands, Deung Cheol-woong forcibly swallowed a moan.
I simply waved my hand, but the warriors at the top of the jewon were mashed like fish meat.
I’ve seen many deaths before, but this was the first time I’ve seen such a terrible death.
No matter how much he is a Kang Ho-in who lives with death by his side, it really wasn’t that kind of death.
‘The crazy old man’s martial arts alone are really amazing.’
He said he was a king, and he really looked like a crazy wolf.
It was as if he hadn’t even thought about the consequences of his actions.
Quaang!
The huge door at the top of the memorial was smashed by King Gu Jin’s light stroke.
At the sound of the front door being smashed, the soldiers inside ran out.
“Who are you?”
“What kind of guy are you?”
They looked at the broken front gate and the face of King Gu Jin. Then, he found Deung Cheol-ung standing behind King Gujin.
“Are you Deung Cheol-woong?”
“Why is the Ark of Blood here…”
They immediately recognized the identity of Deung Cheol-woong.
Deung Cheol-woong said to King Gu Jin.
“Anyway, they don’t seem to want the King to take the sword.”
“joy! I have never had anything I wanted.”
King Gujin snorted and waved his hand.
Whoo!
In an instant, a powerful match broke out and attacked the soldiers at the top of the specification.
“Cheak!”
“evil!”
The warriors flew like leaves swept away by a storm and crashed into the wall.
With their heads broken and their limbs broken, the warriors either fainted or died.
Deung Cheol-woong was fed up watching the sight of dozens of people being incapacitated in an instant.
“Ugh!”
He also boasted that he had gone through all the hardships at the bottom of the river, but he couldn’t help but get tired of King Gu Jin killing people like a fly without emotion.
Dang dang dang!
A bell rang out urgently at the top of the jewon.
Those who were sleeping soundly came out in a hurry.
There were warriors with weapons and ordinary workers.
The warriors pushed the workers back and stepped forward.
“Who is the old manor, and you visit someone else’s manor late at night and cause a commotion?”
It was Gi Hak-soo, the owner of the Ho Sang-dan of the Jewon Company, who stepped forward with a frost-like momentum.
Ki Hak-soo was a great master, though he was not well known to the gang-ho.
However, because of his relationship with the Jewon Company, he kept a distance from Kang Ho for the rest of his life and focused only on protecting the company.
Because of that, the strong people didn’t know about Ki Hak-soo’s existence. But the people around Poyang Lake knew it well.
That’s how great a martial artist Ki Hak-soo is.
His martial arts, cultivated in real battles, deserved to be called one of the strongest.
King Gu Jin smiled.
“You look a bit useful. What is your name?”
“Call me Haksu Ki. What is your senior’s name?”
“My name is King Gu Jin.”
“Nang… the king?”
“okay! I am the queen.”
“Mmm!”
Ki Hak-soo let out a quiet voice.
‘If it’s a king, it’s one of the eight constellations. Why did this wolf-like old man come to the Jewon Headquarters?’
He had a hunch that the scars would be greater than the road today.
King Gujin was a malevolent star that brought blood and wind wherever he went.
No matter how great the jewon corps was, I couldn’t be confident that I could be safe from the wind and blood he called.
“Why did you come to the upper ranks that senior Gu saw?”
“I will not speak. Give me the sword.”
“A sword?”
“I know that there is a treasured sword in the warehouse at the top of the jewon. If you give me the sword, I will return quietly.”
“I don’t know where you heard the nonsense, but there is no treasured sword in the warehouse at the top. There are a few useful swords, but none of them are great enough to meet the level of your seniors.”
“I make the decision. All you have to do is open up the warehouse and show me.”
“haha! We can’t open the warehouse of the jewon top to just anyone. If the corps can’t keep a warehouse and open the door, what will the gangho’s comrades think of us?”
“What do I know? You have only two choices. One is to open the door of the warehouse obediently, and the other is to die by my hand. Which one do you want to choose?”
“I’ve wanted to see the skills of the Eight Constellations for a long time.”
Ki Hak-soo radiated a frost-like momentum.
At that, King Gu Jin snorted.
“Sniff! You don’t even know the subject.”
“I will ask for a lesson. Old senior!”
“teaching? I’m not free enough to teach anyone, and you don’t deserve my teaching.”
“Don’t ignore me, senior!”
“Ignore? I’m just telling the truth.”
“Chaa!”
Ki Hak-soo could not hold back his anger and rushed at King Gu-jin.

chapters.title: Chapter 558
chapters.content:
Episode 558
: Quarreung!
As if an earthquake had occurred, the temples at the top of the memorial shook.
Walls collapsed, roof tiles fell, and workers at the top were injured.
“What is this?”
Jewon Sangdanju Joo Joo-hwan widened his eyes and looked toward the front door.
Kwak!
A continuous explosion erupted from the front door, and powerful air waves raged like a storm.
The air waves were so powerful that they were raging even far away.
Joo Ji-hwan turned and looked at the person next to him.
“mother! I don’t know who it is, but it looks like someone dangerous has broken in. If you stay here, you could get angry, so hurry up and avoid your mother first.”
The person he spoke to was his mother, Noh Tae-tae.
Roh Tae-tae put down the teacup and shook his head.
“I can’t do that, my lord!”
“mother!”
“If the most senior person at the top leaves his seat, saying it is dangerous, who will believe us and follow us? I’m fine, so you and I should avoid your seat.”
“I can’t. I will take care of this place, so please return to Haerojang.”
Joo Joo-hwan regretted bringing Roh Tae-tae, who was staying at Haerojang, for a while. I was thinking of being a companion for Noh Tae-tae, who was alone, so I brought him here, but I didn’t know that this moment would happen.
Noh Tae-tae smiled at Jo Joo-hwan.
“I have always been proud of my family. Although I laid the cornerstone for the top, you are the one who raised it to this extent.”
“mother?”
“The top needs you more than me. So, make your comfort a priority. Never mind this old man who will be gone soon.”
Roh Tae-tae looked toward the front gate, where terrifying air waves were raging, with eyes dripping with ooze.
He was Roh Tae-tae, who did everything he had to do in order to raise the Jewon Association.
At times, they faced life-threatening situations, and sometimes the company went to the brink of ruin due to someone’s cheating.
He did not succumb to any trials and eventually overcame them to create today’s Jewon Sangdan.
Although his strong character also played a part in creating the foundation for the Jewon Sangdan. The keenly developed sixth sense could not be ignored.
Although everything has declined with age, the sixth sense has not declined at all.
Her sixth sense was telling.
Today’s transgression is by no means something that can be avoided.
The air waves felt were unusual.
It felt like thinly slicing the skin with a sharp dagger.
Noh Tae-tae trembled involuntarily.
It was then.
“Sweet Lord!”
An old man in his early sixties approached Joo Joo-hwan.
The old man was the lord of Jeolyeong.
Jeolyeongdae was one of the strengths of the Jewon Sangdae.
As an organization that protects the convoy of the Jewon Corps in the shadows and recovers items when they are lost, it possesses such a powerful force.
Jeolyeongdae was the place that played the biggest role in driving the Blood Guard out of Poyang Lake.
Joo Ji-hwan asked urgently.
“What happened? Who broke in?”
“The King has arrived.”
“Nangwang? You mean the Nangwang of the Eight Constellations?”
“you’re right.”
“Why is he?”
“I don’t know why. Right now, Danju Ki is blocking it, but it won’t last long.”
“Mmm!”
“Avoid. Sovereign Lord!”
“That’s not to say. The owner of the guild abandons the guild and runs away? I am not that kind of person.”
Joo Ji-hwan shook his head.
Like Roh Tae-tae, he had no intention of avoiding any danger.
Jeolyoung Daeju looked at Roh Tae-tae.
There was a lot of meaning in his eyes.
Noah nodded and opened his mouth.
“If the opponent is really a king, it will be difficult for the guild I saw today to avoid being angry.”
“That’s right.”
“However, the owner of the guild cannot show the appearance of running away to avoid anger.”
“Noh Tae-tae.”
“Have you raised your successor well?”
“of course. Thanks to Roh Tae-tae’s consideration, I was able to raise him well.”
“Then you won’t be worried about the heir?”
“yes!”
Jeolyoung Daejoo replied with a smile.
Noh Tae-tae also smiled at his face.
They were not simply employers and subordinates.
It was like a companion who had gone through hardships together for a long time. That’s why we could know each other’s intentions with just a smile and a few words.
Roh Tae-tae said to Jeolyeong-daeju.
“Take Sangsanju to a safe place.”
“yes!”
Jeolyoung Daejoo lowered his head with an answer.
Feeling something suspicious, Joo Joo-hwan hurriedly looked at Roh Tae-tae.
“mother?”
“I’m sorry son! But if you are, you will be able to reconstruct the top of the jewon. I will carry all the karma up until now, so you will raise the Jewon Sangdan again.”
“I’d rather stay. mother!”
“What will I do if I live longer than my children? It is natural for the old man to go first, so this is the right thing to do.”
“mother! It can’t be.”
It was when Joo Joo-hwan cried out.
A young soldier appeared behind him and pointed out that he was of mixed blood.
When Joo Joo-hwan fell unconscious, a young warrior wrapped around him.
Jeolyoung Daeju said to the young warrior.
“Move the Dan Lord to a safe place.”
“yes!”
“Please take care of Danju and the Jaewon Association.”
“Don’t worry, Master!”
The young soldier was a disciple of Jeolyeong Daeju.
He disappeared after being captured by Jeolyeong Daeju and Roh Tae-tae. Jeolyeongdae followed behind him.
Jeolyeong Daeju said to Noh Tae-tae.
“They will be able to reconstruct the jewon pedestal wonderfully.”
“I guess so. Aren’t you resentful of me anyway?”
“Resentment? Thanks to that, I’ve been living with the luxury I’ve been deprived of.”
“You’re barely alive now, and I’m not going to go with you into the pits of Hell?”
“Since you have served them until now, you must serve them even in hell.”
“In your next life, live freely without being bound by this old man.”
“Why are you so sad? Roh Tae-tae was like a mother to me. If it hadn’t been for Roh Tae-tae’s rescue, would the pickpocket in the back alley have lived until now, being treated like a human being? Thanks to you, I lived well in one world, so I will follow you in the next world.”
“With that person…”
It was when Roh Tae-tae shook his head as if he had lost.
Kwaaang!
The main gate in front of Daejeon was destroyed with an explosion. And someone bounced inside.
The one who fell apart in front of Roh Tae-tae and Jeolyeong Dae-ju was Ki Hak-soo, who became a blood relative.
Ki Hak-soo was already dead and could not feel his breath.
“Hehe!”
At that time, King Gu Jin entered with a phoneme.
Both of his hands were drenched in blood.
Behind King Gujin’s back, he could see the horribly destroyed top of the Jewon. And corpses strewn all over the place.
Noah closed his eyes.
King Gu Jin killed not only Ki Hak-soo, but also all the warriors who stood in his way.
It was a brutal hand-to-hand.
It was a sight to see why King Gu Jin was called a blood-crazed wolf in Gangho.
Behind King Gujin’s back, Cheolung Deung could be seen.
As soon as he saw Deung Cheol-woong, Jeol Yeong-dae-ju realized what had happened.
“That guy was the troublemaker. Bringing disaster into the Bone Merchant.”
It was Jeolyoung Daeju who attacked Juseolpung and Bloody Room.
At that time, I kept feeling sorry for missing Deung Cheol-woong, but in the end, it caused this sadal.
“Inom!”
“Hee!”
Deung Cheol-woong became a turtle neck after the lion of Jeolyeong Daeju and was frightened.
Then King Gu Jin stepped forward and let out a mute.
“Hehe! He’s a guy with a lot of energy. It would be more fun to deal with than him.”
“Old senior!”
“Who do you mean senior? A guy who can’t even be a slob…”
“Whoo!”
At King Gu Jin’s words, Jeolyeong Daeju sighed.
This violent, savage human doesn’t think much of anyone but himself when he’s caught between his claws.
It was to the point of resenting the heavens for allowing such a human to have this level of power.
At that time, Noh Tae-tae stepped forward and said.
“How can you live so selflessly with such mighty martial arts? If he had conformed to the world a little more, he would have made his name great.”
“Hehe! I don’t care about being worshiped after I die. After death, everything is over, so why do you live with your own desires?”
“Why don’t you know that sometimes there are banners that are more important than desires?”
“Noisy old man! Do not try to seduce me with such doctrines.”
“Good! king. What did you come to the upper ranks for?”
“I know that there is a famous sword in the report. If you give me the famous sword, I will quietly leave.”
“There is no treasured sword in the chief’s report that would attract the attention of the king. Also, even if I had it, I couldn’t give it to you.”
“Even if you’re going to die?”
“Sometimes there are things more precious than death. If I open the report to you, I may be able to save my life, but instead, the reputation of the Bone Merchant will fall to the bottom. If that happens, the chief may remain alive, but he will never be able to earn the respect of others again.”
“So you can’t open the report? Hehe! Are you risking your life for useless pride?”
“You will find out later whether it will be useless or not.”
“If it’s okay and you won’t open it yourself, I will kill everyone and open it with my own power.”
“You will never have what you want.”
Noh Tae-tae said with a determined expression.
Sussuk!
At that moment, about 20 unmanned people appeared behind her.
Except for those who escaped with Joo Joo-hwan, they were unarmed.
All the young warriors escaped with Joo Joo-hwan, and the rest were all elderly.
“Cheeky things! But no matter how many ants gather, they cannot stop the wolves.”
“An ant is also an ant. You will learn today that there are ants that are sick when bitten.”
Roh Tae-tae opened his eyes and glared at King Gu Jin.
Her resolute determination reached King Gu Jin. King Gujin did not like this situation.
“I will kill them all.”
Sreung!
He pulled out one of the swords he was carrying on his back.
It was a gold medal recently obtained.
Seeing this, Daeju Jeolyeong gave an order.
“Attack!”
“Chaa!”
The warriors attacked King Gujin all at once.
Their swords and swords slashed through King Gujin’s whole body.
At that moment, King Gu Jin swung his golden sword.
Shua!
Formidable swordsmanship stretched out like the teeth of a comb.
The swordsman cut the five warriors who were running from the front.
Fu Chemistry!
“evil!”
“Heuk!”
A huge amount of blood splattered in all directions and the screams of the warriors echoed throughout the manor.
It was Cheonrang Blood Sword (天狼血牙劍), the Dokmun Swordsmith of King Gujin.
A rare swordsman who possessed the power of a comrade, but the recoil was so great that he shattered all swordsmen.
Because of that, King Gu Jin came to covet famous swords such as Horror and Golden Hwang.
Its power was certain.
Whoo!
Even though he pulled out the formidable sword like a stick, the golden sword was intact.
“Cheak!”
“Keck!”
The warriors of the Jewon Corps died over and over again.
“Ha ha ha!”
King Gu Jin fired a mad light and slaughtered the warriors.
“Ha!”
Jeolyeong Daeju attacked him with all his might.
But he looked precarious, like a moth leaping into a campfire.
Roh Tae-tae opened his eyes wide and looked at Jeolyeong Dae-joo from behind.
It was the final battle of those who had followed him for the rest of their lives.
He was responsible for keeping his eyes on the end.
King Gujin was the end of an era.
As a result, the Jewon Sangdan will collapse today, but the Jewon Sangdan will come back to life.
They will grow bigger and more splendid by taking the death of themselves and them as fertilizer.
That was the reason she didn’t leave this place.
‘Still, I lived very well.’

chapters.title: Chapter 559
chapters.content:
Episode 559
Pyowol came out of the house.
A small river flowing slowly and low mountains surrounding the basin like a folding screen. And along the hill, I saw rice fields made like stairs and the appearance of villagers working in them.
It was a beautiful landscape like a painting.
It was a quiet village located not far from Poyang Lake.
The village was so peaceful that it was hard to believe that it was close to Lake Poyang, where the Great War was taking place.
This is because the village is so small and has nothing to do with Gangho, so it did not attract people’s attention.
The population of the village was only fifty, and they all made a living by farming rice fields and catching fish in the river.
I can’t say that I’m so rich, but I still lived with my mouth.
Since there was little interaction with the outside world, most of the villagers were naive.
“I didn’t find a safe place to go to a place like this.”
Pyowol was once again amazed by Salno’s ability.
A place that is not too far from Poyang Lake and is completely away from the attention of the strong literary faction.
It was truly a hideaway.
Thanks to this, Pyo-wol was able to rest comfortably for the first time since coming here.
“ah! He is a handsome older brother.”
“Wow!”
When Pyowol came out, the children who were playing nearby came running.
They laughed and chatted while hovering nearby, as if they weren’t afraid of the moon.
Pyowol frowned slightly.
Because I’m not used to this kind of fuss.
“Where is your brother from?”
“How is it outside?”
The children surrounded Pyowol and made noise like larks.
Pyowol shook his head slightly and moved on. Then the children followed Pyowol like chicks following their mother hen.
The children laughed and chatted as if they were not afraid of strangers they were seeing for the first time.
Pyowol made a slight impression.
If he was a warrior who had learned martial arts, he would have felt a serious threat just by changing the impression of Pyowol. However, the innocent children did not know the meaning behind the change in Pyowol’s expression. That’s why I laughed and talked even more.
“huh?”
Pyowol suddenly looked down. Then a little girl, now five or six years old, was holding Pyowol’s finger.
As Pyowol and her eyes met, the girl said.
“hug me!”
“…”
“Hug me!”
When Pyo-wol did not respond, the girl spoke again and waved her hand.
Pyowol stared at the girl. The girl also stared at Pyowol.
It was Pyowol who averted his gaze first.
For some reason, I couldn’t look at the girl’s innocent eyes for a long time.
It was Pyowol who never averted his gaze no matter what formidable enemy he encountered, but the girl’s eyes were strangely difficult to handle.
Pyowol asked.
“You want a hug?”
“huh! hug me.”
Pyowol carefully hugged the girl and lifted her up. Then the girl spoke again.
“Above the shoulder.”
“You want me to upload it?”
“huh!”
The girl nodded.
Pyowol sat the girl on his shoulder. Then, as if he liked the girl, he smiled widely.
“wow! Look good!”
Pyo-wol carried the girl on his shoulders and moved to the riverside.
After that, the children followed as if it were natural.
Farmers who were farming in terraced rice fields also saw the sight.
It would be worrying to see children following a strange man, but there was no sign of that at all.
The girl whispered while sitting on Pyowol’s shoulder.
“Pretty!”
“huh?”
“brother! It’s pretty. I will marry my brother.”
“…”
Pyo-wol was at a loss for words at the girl’s bold words. But after a while, Pyowol shook his head.
“That seems difficult.”
“why?”
“I am not from here.”
“Then are you leaving?”
“huh!”
“no!”
“Sorry! I still can’t live here.”
Tears welled up in the girl’s eyes at Pyowol’s indifferent answer.
Pyo-wol wiped the girl’s tears with her white hand.
“Everyone has their own life. This place doesn’t suit me.”
“Why don’t you fit in?”
“They were born differently. If I am in a peaceful place like this, this place will also become chaotic.”
“difficult!”
“The world is kind of like that. It’s difficult. You will know when you grow up.”
“I don’t know! I just want to marry my brother.”
Pyo-wol smiled involuntarily at the girl’s forced appearance.
It was then.
“It looks good.”
Suddenly, a muffled voice was heard.
Pyo-wol was not surprised and looked back.
Before I knew it, Salno had appeared and settled down.
Pyowol dropped the girl off and said.
“Now play with your friends.”
“huh!”
The girl ran to her friends playing nearby.
Pyo-wol looked at it for a moment, then moved his gaze back to Salno.
“You came quickly.”
“I have something urgent to report.”
“in haste? Is there a problem with Brain or Ye-seol?”
“no. They are faithfully carrying out the mission commanded by the Most High. News will come sooner or later that the mission has been completed.”
“if?”
“A change has occurred at Lake Poyang.”
“Change?”
“Specifications…the upper ranks are said to have been attacked.”
“who? Is it a golden age?”
“no. King Gujin attacked the Jewon Sangdan.”
“A king?”
Pyowol’s eyes grew cold.
For a moment, Salno felt a chill run down his spine and flinched.
Pyowol asked.
“So what about the damage?”
“Fortunately, the merchants and workers escaped and were not harmed, but the unmanned soldiers suffered serious damage. Half of the warriors of the Jewon Corps were slaughtered by Nangwang. Fortunately, Sang Sangju escaped with his subordinates and saved his life…”
Salno was speechless.
Pyowol looked at Salno’s face and said.
“Looks like someone else died instead.”
“yes!”
“No… Tae-tae?”
“That’s right.”
Pyowol closed her eyes.
I thought that might be the case ever since I heard that the Jewon Sangdan was in trouble.
Forebodings have never been wrong. But this time, he hoped his hunch was wrong.
No matter how much he said that he was a person who lived his life, it was because he wanted to close his eyes comfortably for the last time.
Salno continued.
“It is said that Roh Tae-tae escaped Sang Sang-ju and remained until the end. Despite King Gujin’s threatening threat, he endured until the end…”
“You saved the reputation of the Jewon Sangdan with your own life.”
“yes! It’s a great heroine. Even in such an urgent situation, it was calculated up to that point. The report was robbed, but the financial damage was not that great.”
When the size of the top of the specification is reached, the property is never stored in a single warehouse. It is distributed and stored in several warehouses.
The Jewon Sangdae collapsed due to the catastrophic existence of King Nangwang Gujin, but with her death, he kept his pride.
He not only saved his pride, but also saved the lives of his son, Joo Joo-hwan, and other blood relatives. Even so, he did not allow himself to be cursed at.
Although it suffered a great blow because of King Gujin, Jewon Sangdan will surely be rebuilt splendidly.
“Where is King Gujin?”
“Shall we track it?”
“Track it!”
“All right.”
Salno did not hesitate to answer politely.
sting!
My skin tingled as if I had come into contact with the brain.
There was no change in his master’s expression. But Salno knew.
How angry he was right now and what a huge murderous intent he had.
The tingling feeling he felt now was proof that Pyowol was angry.
Pyowol immediately returned to the safe house.
He took off the plain clothes he had been wearing and changed into a black uniform.
Around her waist, she wore a leather belt made by Dang Sochu and hid two daggers inside.
After putting on a pair of Vambraces on his forearms, he finally donned the bloody clothes that Dang Xiaochu had made for him.
When I came out after completing such perfect preparations, Salno was nowhere to be seen.
In order to carry out Pyowol’s order, he left the village one step ahead.
Pyo-wol looked back at the village for a moment.
The sound of children playing was combined with the beautiful scenery like a picture.
Pyowol murmured.
“Sorry! I’m used to it now…”
Probably never coming back here again.
Pyo-wol moved out of the village.
“brother!”
Then a girl’s voice was heard.
Looking at the source of the sound, I saw a girl waving her hand.
“You have to come back.”
The girl shouted at her throat, but Pyowol did not answer.
After looking at the girl for a while, Pyowol quickly left the village.
He walked quickly along the shady mountain road.
After an hour or so, I joined Guan Dao.
After walking along the Guando for a long time, I saw a familiar landscape in the distance.
It was Lake Poyang, a vast lake that could not be captured at a glance.
Arriving at Lake Poyang, Pyowol immediately headed for the top of Jewon.
It was not that difficult to find the top of the jewon because I had already been there once.
There were many unmanned guards outside the top of the jewon.
Pyo-wol recognized that they were Unryeonhoe soldiers.
‘Looks like a blizzard came.’
Even if he came, it wasn’t strange at all.
Even though he said he had cut off ties with the Jewon Sangdan to work in the union association, that didn’t mean he had completely cut off his blood and kinship.
Roh Tae-tae provided a lot of support in the shadows so that Ju Seol-pung could unleash his power.
Ju Seol-pung was also very fond of his great-grandmother Roh Tae-tae, and he never did not worry about safety for a moment.
Therefore, as soon as I heard the news that the Jewon Corps had suffered a catastrophe, I was the first to run.
Pyo-wol looked at the warriors surrounding the top of the memorial for a while and threw himself away.
Despite being guarded by numerous soldiers, no one noticed that Pyowol was intruding into the top of the jewon.
Like a stray cat, Pyo-wol landed on the hall at the top of the memorial and looked around the inside without making a sound.
From the front gate to the inner palace, it was seen that it was destroyed in a straight line.
It was the route through which King Gujin invaded.
There were clear blood stains on the floor that had not yet been erased.
The red bloodstains showed how cruel King Gu Jin’s hand was.
Pyowol walked inward along the roof of the palace.
The further inside, the stronger the traces of destruction remained. And there was a body that hadn’t been recovered yet.
Even though his breath had stopped, the expression of pain and despair remained vivid.
I knew how much fear they felt before they died.
As I passed their bodies and went inside, I saw a group of people.
It was Jang Joo-hwan and his blood relatives, who had escaped during King Gu-jin’s attack.
They were looking ahead with indignant faces.
Pyowol quietly descended from the roof of the palace and intervened between them.
Bodies covered in white cloth lay in a row in front of Joo Joo-hwan and his blood relatives.
Among them was the body of Noh Tae-tae.
“mother! Hehehe!”
“Grandma!”
“Huh!”
They shed tears when they saw Roh Tae-tae’s body.
Although Roh Tae-tae had passed away, he maintained the gentle expression he had before.
If it wasn’t for this horror, it was an expression that could have been mistaken for falling asleep.
Pyo-wol looked at Noh Tae-tae without a word.
Just then, a man quietly approached him.
He stood next to the moon and said.
“Fortunately, he died in a single blow. He didn’t feel much pain.”
The man’s voice was full of moisture.
Pyo-wol recognized the man’s identity without even looking back.
“Lord…Snowstorm!”
“Top Daehyeop!”
The man was Roh Tae-tae’s great-grandson Ju Seol-pung.

chapters.title: Chapter 560
chapters.content:
Episode 560 Ju
Seol-Pung’s eyes were bloodshot red and his face was swollen.
The first to run to the news that the Jewon Corps had suffered a catastrophe.
Externally, he disguised himself as having cut ties with the Jewon Association, but he could not maintain such a disguise until his great-grandmother’s death.
He led the warriors of the Unryeonhoe and ran to the top of the memorial. However, when he arrived, King Gu Jin disappeared after turning the report of the Jewon Merchant.
When Roh Tae-tae’s body was found among the corpses of countless people, the Ju-seol-wind collapsed.
All night long, I hugged Roh Tae-tae’s body and cried.
I cried so much that my throat was hoarse and my voice couldn’t come out properly.
Pyowol looked at the main snow wind.
“Are you okay?”
“it’s okay. I’m not weak enough to break down just this much.”
“I’m glad.”
“thank you. For running like this.”
“She was a good person.”
“yes! He was a good man.”
“But he died.”
“yes! I lost my life at the hands of King Gu Jin.”
“Why did King Gu Jin attack the Jewon Sangdan and kill her?”
“I think it’s because of the sword in the family’s treasury.”
“knife?”
“Looks like Grandpa recently got a pretty decent sword.”
More than that, I could understand without hearing an explanation.
This is because they already know the history of King Gu Jin.
A blizzard blew through.
“To kill so many people with just one sword.”
“What are you going to do next?”
“I must take revenge.”
“Do you have the confidence to do it?”
“I have to do without it.”
“What about the union association?”
“No matter how important the union association is, it is less than the revenge of my great-grandmother.”
Awesome!
The blizzard gnashed his teeth.
He grinded so hard that blood flowed from his gums.
Pyo-wol stared at Ju Seol-pung’s face.
“I am an assassin.”
“yes?”
“I take a request and kill people.”
“…”
Only then did Ju Seol-pung realize what Pyo-wol wanted to say.
The eyes of the two met in midair.
Pyo-wol did not avoid the hot gaze of the main snow wind.
After a while, the snow wind opened its mouth with difficulty.
“I’ll make a request for you! The target is Nangwang, Gujinwang, and the price is…”
“One coin is all it takes.”
“That’s…”
“That’s exactly what King Gujin is worth to me.”
“All right. Will you accept my request for a coin?”
“I accept it.”
“thank you.”
Ju Seol-Pung took a hug from Pyo-Wol and lowered his head.
After a while, when he raised his head again, Pyowol’s figure had disappeared and was nowhere to be seen.
It was then.
“Snowstorm! Come here.”
Joo Ji-hwan, who was immersed in grief, sang Ju-seol-wind.
“yes! grandfather.”
With the answer, Ju Seol-pung approached Joo Joo-hwan.
Overnight, Joo Ji-hwan seemed to have aged by several decades.
If he hadn’t been obsessed with revenge, he could have let go of his life altogether.
Joo Joo-hwan looked at Roh Tae-tae’s body and said,
“I should have died instead of my mother. My mother should have lived instead of me.”
“That would not have been what my great-grandmother wanted. grandfather.”
“The thing that this human-like old man killed his great-grandmother and the warriors of the headquarters is a sword.”
“…”
“Do you understand? It means that all these deaths are worth only one sword. So many people died because of just one slightly harder and slightly sharper sword.”
“grandfather?”
“Are human lives so worthless? I can’t possibly forgive him.”
“So do i.”
“I would kill that old man even if I had to spend tens of millions of dollars. I will kill that old man with his blood, even if I scatter all my possessions on all the ronin and munpa in the world.”
“You don’t have to.”
“You’re not trying to make a foolish remark that revenge calls for revenge, right?”
Joo Ji-hwan looked at the snow wind with burning eyes.
The main snow wind shook his head slightly and replied.
“Could that be?”
“if?”
“Already commissioned.”
“To whom? if?”
“yes! The Shinigami has received my request.”
“good night! Then I will not give him a burial of the dead until he brings the old man’s head.”
Joo Ji-hwan declared in front of everyone.
＊＊＊
King Gu Jin looked at the sword on the table with a dissatisfied expression.
A noble feeling was exuded from the scabbard and handle engraved with antique patterns.
Even at a glance, I could tell that it was a treasured sword made a long time ago. However, it was far short of winning the eyes of King Gu Jin.
“Sometimes trash is a treasured sword.”
Sreung!
he drew his sword
A straight sword body and a sharpened blade caught my eye.
It was definitely a well-made sword.
It was probably made by a famous artisan with great care.
The problem is that this sword is a ceremonial sword, not for actual combat.
A ceremonial sword used during ancestral rites.
It may look beautiful on the outside, but both balance and strength fall far short of King Gu Jin’s standard.
The result obtained after making the huge merchant company called Jewon Sangdan into a mess was less than expected.
“To think of keeping a sword like this in the treasury. Jewon Sangdanju is out of his mind.”
King Gujin put the sword back into its scabbard and set it beside the table.
At that time, Deung Cheol-woong, who was carefully watching him, opened his mouth.
“Don’t you like the sword?”
“joy! It looks good only on the surface, but it will probably break soon if you fight a proper warrior.”
“Sorry.”
“Why are you greedy?”
“How am I?”
“Hehe! Your eyes are full of greed, but do you tell lies that the seed will not be eaten?”
“sorry.”
“done. If you’re that greedy, you’ll have it.”
“Are you really…?”
“I don’t have enough free time to lie to you.”
“Then thank you.”
Deung Cheol-woong quickly handed over the sword.
King Gu Jin snorted as he saw Deung Cheol-woong hugging his sword tightly.
“It’s a pearl necklace around a pig’s neck.”
King Gu Jin’s words made him feel bad, but Deung Cheol-ung didn’t show it that way at all.
Deung Cheol-woong, who had been enjoying the feel of the sword for a while, cautiously spoke to King Gu Jin.
“But what are you going to do next?”
“What do you mean?”
“I made the top of the jewon in that shape, so I won’t be alone at the union meeting.”
“joy! What if all the things don’t stay?”
“There is Gwangmumun Gate behind the Unryeonhoe.”
“Gwangmumun?”
“Lee Geom-han, who has newly become the owner of Eunryeonhoe, is the owner of Gwangmumun. He will not be alone.”
“Gwangmumun would be a bit troublesome.”
King Gujin frowned.
He said that, but he couldn’t be relieved if Gwangmumun really moved.
Gwangmumun, the loser of the north, was an opponent that could not be underestimated.
In particular, Lee Chung, the head of Gwangmumun, was an existence he could not dare to deal with.
If he moved directly, King Gu Jin had to be regarded as dead.
When King Gu Jin made an agitated expression, Deung Cheol-woong carefully brought up the main topic.
“There is a good way.”
“What is it?”
“How about entrusting yourself to the Golden Temple?”
“Geumcheonhoe?”
“yes! Isn’t Jang Moo-geuk, the head of the Geumcheonhoe, the head of the Cheonmujang? Even Gwangmumun will not be able to touch Cheonmujang.”
The moment Deung Cheol-woong mentioned Cheonmu-jang, King Gu Jin’s face contorted.
King Gu Jin hit Deung Cheol-woong with his fist.
Kwajik!
“Keeck!”
Deung Cheol-woong stretched out like a frog with a scream.
King Gujin rose from his seat while smoking a fire.
“If you look at me in a funny way, are you doing such a foolish thing?”
“Keuk Kuk! sorry.”
“If you talk nonsense one more time, then I will take your life.”
“I will be careful.”
Deung Cheol-woong rubbed his chest and stood up cautiously.
Fortunately, King Gu Jin kept the situation in his hands, so he was not seriously injured. Still, it was enough to raise his awareness.
‘You crazy old man! Still, I said it because I was thinking of myself. I don’t know where the really crazy things will bounce.’
Deung Cheol-woong thought it was time to step out.
Although they succeeded in making the top of the Jewon a mess by using King Gu Jin, it could be dangerous if they went together more than this.
One hand is hard to block ten hands is the reason of the world, and King Gu Jin bought too much resentment.
Right now, thanks to the mighty martial arts, you can pass without getting hurt, but as time goes by, you will definitely move at the union association level. In that case, no matter how strong King Gu Jin was, he would eventually be defeated or killed.
If you stay next to an angular guy and then continue to hang out with King Gujin, claiming that you are right, you will not be able to escape your anger. So, at this point, I had to part with King Gu Jin.
However, since King Gu Jin’s personality was so erratic, he was cautious about even mentioning it.
King Gu Jin glared at Deung Cheol-woong with wolf-like cold eyes and said,
“I can hear your head rolling from here. Stop messing around and come over here and pour yourself a drink.”
“yes!”
Deung Cheol-woong bowed his head and approached King Gu Jin again.
‘Shit! It’s like a ghost noticed by a crazy old man…’
Inwardly, he cursed King Gu Jin, but his face was filled with a servile smile.
That was the secret of Deung Cheol-woong’s survival.
For a strong man, bowing his head without hesitation and looking for a chance to stab him in the back was what he did best.
Deung Cheol-woong filled King Gu Jin’s cup with wine.
“Big!”
King Gujin drank at once and wiped his mouth with his sleeve.
Suddenly, he pulled out one of the two swords he was carrying on his back.
It was fear.
“As expected, there is no one other than this guy. Taking this sword from that young bastard is the best thing I ever did in my life.”
“fear? It looks like a great sword.”
“It’s not like a sword, it’s a real sword. Although it looks rough, I’ve never seen a sword as good as this one. The only sword that can be compared is Golden Hwang, but even that is a bit inferior compared to this guy.”
“Is that so?”
In an instant, the light of greed flashed in Deung Cheol-woong’s eyes as well.
The sword that King Gu Jin gave to him was also a great sword. However, King Gujin talked about the sword as if it were no big deal. If so, I couldn’t imagine how great the sword King Gu Jin was holding in his hand would be.
‘If only I could have that sword…’
Greed raised its head in the chest. However, Deung Cheol-woong thoroughly concealed his intentions.
King Gu Jin would not stand still if he knew that he was greedy for the sword.
Deung Cheol-woong said as he poured the wine into King Gu Jin’s cup again.
“What do you plan to do now?”
“what?”
“Since there was such a fuss, shouldn’t we come up with a countermeasure?”
“Measures? That’s what the weak do. It doesn’t matter if a strong person like me doesn’t have to come up with a separate countermeasure.”
“But…”
“If you say one more word, I will rip your mouth out.”
“yes!”
Deung Cheol-woong kept his mouth shut like a porridge. However, he couldn’t hide the dissatisfied expression on his face.
It was the moment when King Gu Jin was about to speak out.
Suddenly, his eyes trembled.
“what?”
“yes? Why are you like this all of a sudden?”
Deung Cheol-woong looked at him with a puzzled expression.
Instead of answering, King Gujin glared at the window and suddenly swung the fear he was holding in his hand.
Awesome!
With a sharp cutting sound, the crescent-shaped blade of sword slashed through the window and flew outside.
Then King Gujin jumped up and shouted.
“How dare a rat peek into my lair. I’ll rip its jaws open.”

chapters.title: Chapter 561
chapters.content:
Episode 561
!
The branches of a large tree were snapped off by King Gujin’s sword strike. Subsequently, King Gu Jin landed on a tree.
King Gujin frowned.
Because there was no one around the tree.
“No one? I definitely felt the presence.”
Belatedly, Deung Cheol-woong ran out of the inn.
“Why is that?”
King Gu Jin did not answer Deung Cheol-woong’s question.
A little while ago, he felt a gaze secretly peeking into his abode.
It was never an illusion.
It is absurd for a master who has reached his level to misunderstand the eyes of others.
‘Who are you?’
King Gujin looked around for the owner of his gaze. However, the owner of the gaze could not be found anywhere on the street.
It was late at night, and there were hardly any people on the streets, and the occasional passers-by were drunk people.
‘Is it really an illusion?’
It was a time when King Gu Jin doubted his senses.
Cheer!
I felt someone’s secret gaze again.
It was not an illusion.
Clearly, someone was secretly watching him.
“There you are.”
King Gujin flew towards the place where he felt his gaze.
It was on the roof of the building next door.
Shia!
King Gu Jin spread his arms wide like a bat and flew and landed on the roof. But there was no one on the roof where he landed.
King Gujin’s face was distorted.
“How dare you tease me? Come on bastard!”
Whoo!
he yelled.
Leaves fell in torrents at the sound of his inner strength.
At that moment, King Gu Jin did not miss the glimpse of someone behind the tree.
“There you are.”
King Gujin threw himself into the tree in front.
At that moment, a black figure hiding in a tree escaped from him.
“Do you know how to miss it? Chaat!”
King Gujin shouted loudly and pursued the black figure.
Shia!
They raced down the street at breakneck speed.
King Gujin’s light engineering technique, Pyopungnangwangbo (漂風狼王步), could be said to be one of the strongest.
King Gujin was like a wolf running full speed through the wind.
No one could stop his run.
He pursued the black figure, deflecting everything in his path.
“Cheak!”
“100 million!”
With a scream, the people who collided with King Gu Jin were thrown out.
There were also unmanned people among them, but the result was the same.
All broke like broken firewood and flew in all directions.
It was truly ignorant racing.
It was something he could not have done if he had noticed even a little bit of attention from the people around him or from the literary faction lined up around Poyang Lake.
It was a crazy thing that he could do because he became King Gu Jin.
However, no matter how much King Gu Jin unfolded Pyopungnangwangbo with all his might, he could not catch up with the black In-young running in front of him.
The black figure was like a mirage.
An illusion that can be caught if you stretch out your hand, but cannot be caught.
Even unlike King Gu Jin, he was running away from everyone on the street. Even so, the distance between the two did not decrease at all, but rather widened.
It was proof that the black man-young’s light engineering skills were superior to King Gu Jin’s.
‘crazy! Is this possible?’
King Gujin bit his lip.
He was very proud of himself.
I thought that not only martial arts but also light martial arts were the best. However, the black man’s light engineering shattered his pride.
“I will never forgive you. bloke!”
He could not forgive the black human figure who shattered his pride.
Shia!
King Gujin threw his sword against the back of the black figure.
The bloody sword flew in a straight line. However, the black figure moved slightly to the side as if it had eyes on its back, avoiding the sword strike.
Quaang!
Swordsman only broke down the poor wall.
When this happened, King Gujin’s anger rose to the tip of his head.
King Gujin pursued him with the determination to rip and kill the black human figure.
Fortunately, the distance did not widen further.
It was probably clear that the black figure was luring him.
It didn’t matter though.
He’ll think he’s lured him in, but he’ll regret his decision the moment he reaches his destination.
The black figure escaped from the busy streets and entered the reed field by Poyang Lake.
A field of reeds that grew taller than an adult was swaying like waves in the wind.
‘Is this a trap prepared by you? But it won’t work for me.’
King Gujin jumped into the reed field without hesitation.
I couldn’t find a black seal on the wall of reeds that covered my eyes.
“Chaa!”
King Gujin let out a cheer and swung his sword wide.
Shigaak!
In an instant, powerful sword energy was ejected from his sword in a straight line.
Reed leaves cut off by the sword flew up into the air.
I could see a black figure standing among the reed leaves that were slowly falling.
King Gujin strode towards him.
“Looks like they all ran away. Reveal your identity.”
Sreung!
King Gujin even took out the golden hwang.
With fear and gold in both hands, his momentum was truly terrifying.
The black figure did not move either, as if he had given up running away.
King Gujin continued, aiming at the black human spirit with fear.
“Whether you reveal your identity or not, you will die by my hand. If you want to die painlessly, you’d better reveal yourself.”
“I still have that sword.”
“what?”
King Gu Jin made a puzzled expression at the words of the black man.
Because he said it as if he knew him from before.
Ignoring his suspicious gaze, the black figure continued.
“It was a horror. The name of that sword is…”
“Who are you?”
“It is always like that. Those who have been robbed shed tears of blood and cannot forget the memory of that day, but those who plundered and harassed them easily forget.”
“Stop talking nonsense and reveal your true identity. bloke!”
At that moment, the black figure took off the hat attached to the blood jacket. Then, a beautiful face that could hardly be called a man was revealed under the moonlight.
King Gu Jin immediately recognized the man’s identity.
“You are that assassin.”
“King Gujin!”
“Hehe! Your liver is swollen. How dare you provoke me on the subject of an assassin.”
“Your personality is still impatient.”
“I know you’ve gained a reputation lately. Reaper? I got a nickname that wasn’t even funny. So, did you feel a little more confident? How dare you provoke me.”
King Gu Jin radiated a formidable life force.
The reeds in the area swayed madly from the life he radiated.
He still looked ferocious.
Pyowol looked at King Gujin with deeply sunken eyes.
In the past, when he clashed with King Gu Jin, Pyo-wol put him into a predicament by exerting 10 percent of his killing skills. However, if the duel time had been longer, it was impossible to predict how the fight would turn out.
King Gujin had as much air power and martial arts skills as he had lived. In comparison, Pyo-wol was a youngster who had just been released from Gangho.
How did he inflict considerable wounds on King Gu Jin, but in the end he could not completely subdue him. So, King Gujin took away the fear and went into hiding, and Soma went into the shaman faction.
Had King Gu Jin been killed then, Roh Tae-tae would not have lost his life.
It is said that the day of death is not far away, but there is a big difference between dying to the fullest and losing one’s life at the hands of others.
It wasn’t too difficult to find King Gujin.
Because I had no intention of hiding at all.
If ordinary people committed such a big incident, they would have hidden away from people’s eyes, but King Gu Jin had no such thing.
Since I had lived my life without caring about other people’s eyes all my life, hiding was not an option at all.
Because of the situation, Salno easily found the place where King Gujin was. It was so easy that it was all futile.
King Gu Jin’s life amplified.
It was King Gujin, who had a fiery reputation as a member of the Eight Constellations a long time ago. Now that I’m older, the wrinkles on my face have increased, but my martial arts have deepened.
It is not foolish to be ferocious.
He did not neglect martial arts just because he lived his own way.
Rather, I was more immersed in martial arts to live freely.
Thanks to that, his martial arts were much stronger than before.
Although he couldn’t catch up with Pyowol with light martial arts, he was confident that he was superior in martial arts.
Moreover, he had two famous swords.
fear and gold.
Thanks to the two swords obtained from different places, he was able to unleash the heavenly blood sword with all his might.
There was a big difference between being able to do your best and not being able to.
“Where are you going to try your best? Assassin!”
King Gujin roared and rushed at Pyowol.
Wow!

“Ah yes!”
Joo Ji-hwan put on a puzzled expression.
It was because there was no need to mention that Ju Seol-pung belonged to the Union Association.
Because of this, if Jang Moo-geuk of the Geumcheonhoe had a grudge against the top of the Jewon, it would be embarrassing.
Fortunately, however, Jang Moo-geuk and Jang Ho-yeon did not look very upset about this.
Jang Wu-geuk said while holding hands.
“This is Geumcheon Hoeju Jangmu-geuk. How much will you mourn when the oldest member of your family dies? I hope you go to a better place.”
“Thank you, Chang Hui-ju.”
“Today is purely to pray for the soul, so don’t mind us. At least there won’t be any riots here.”
“ah!”
“By the way, when do you expect to be buried?”
“That’s…”
Joo Joo-hwan hesitated, unable to answer easily.
Then someone walked out of the crowd and said.
“I will not bury it until I avenge my great-grandmother.”
“hmm!”
Everyone sighed at the unexpected reply.
The owner of the voice was Joo Seol-pung, the grandson of Joo Joo-hwan and the great-grandson of the late Roh Tae-tae.
The main snow wind looked at the four people with bloodshot eyes.
Jang Wu-geuk opened his mouth.
“I know King Nangwang Gu Jin is a beast, but is revenge possible? I can help you if you want.”
“He is a member of the Union Federation. If you’re helping me avenge it, I’ll do it, not you.”
Lee Geom-han stepped forward and kept Jang Mu-geuk in check.
If Jang Moo-geuk avenges Roh Tae-tae, Ju Seol-pung and the Jewon Sangdan will owe him. If that happened, it would be a huge loss for the union association.
Even if revenge was sought, the Union Association had to do it, not give the Geumcheon Association a reason to intervene.
Zhang Wuji said with a smile.
“Is there any reason to take your side in the face of revenge? Everything is his choice.”
“While I couldn’t see you, only your words increased. How can you make such sophistry casually?”
“You’ve become timid while I haven’t seen you. How can a person who cannot even avenge his subordinates lead a huge force?”
“The Union Association is already tracking King Gu Jin.”
“You mean you haven’t caught it yet? You seem to know how incompetent the Union Association is.”
“I wonder how capable Geumcheonhoe is. Isn’t it the same place that ordered King Gu Jin?”
“Be careful with your words.”
Zhang Muji’s eyes widened.
In an instant, a tremendous air wave was emitted, and all the objects inside the upper deck shook as if an earthquake had occurred.
“Keugh!”
“Ouch!”
The faces of the workers at the jewon top were drawn.
They didn’t have the capacity to handle the spirit of a person who reached the same level as Zhang Wu-geuk.
At that time, Lee Geom-han stepped forward and blocked Jang Mu-geuk’s wave.
“Do that.”
“Did you forget that it was you who provoked it first?”
“I wouldn’t have provoked you if you hadn’t touched a nerve first.”
“I know you are lucky. That this is a funeral home, not a battlefield.”
“In that case, you would have died by my hand.”
A spark seemed to fly between the two of them.
No one dared to stop them.
At that time, Jang Ho-yeon and Namgung-seol stood next to them.
“You better fix it now.”
“It is a place to commemorate the deceased. You won’t hear good things if you have to confront more than this.”
They each stopped Mu-geuk Jang and Geom-han Lee.
Only then did the two of them retract and take a step back.
The temperature of the room, which had been hot, went down.
“Whew!”
“I lived.”
The workers breathed a sigh of relief.
Namgungseol whispered to Lee Geomhan.
“It was too hasty. You need to be a little calmer.”
“I’m sorry. It’s been a while since I’ve seen you, and my blood is boiling.”
“i know. But now is the time to mourn, not the time to swing your fists. We have agreed to a truce with the Geumcheonhoe for the next three days, so swing your fists freely after that.”
“Three days?”
“At least for that long, you have to pretend to be mourning. That way, we won’t lose public sentiment.”
“I know.”
“That’s all right.”
Namgungseol smiled and looked at the front.
Jang Ho-yeon was also smiling as if he had succeeded in persuading Jang Mu-geuk.
Joo Ji-hwan said to four people.
“Since you’ve come here, go have a meal.”
“Thank you.”
“I will.”
Joo Ji-hwan ordered workers to guide the four people to tables far apart from each other.
It was only when they were so far away that Jang Joo-hwan let out a sigh of relief.
“Phew! What is this…”
I was so nervous that sweat was running down my forehead.
I really didn’t know that the owners of the Geumcheonhoe and Eunryeonhoe would visit at the same time.
They were so bad that it wouldn’t be strange even if they were stabbed right away.
“Phew! It would have been better not to receive condolences.”
If there were no condolences at all, this kind of sadal would not have happened. However, it was also difficult to completely block the people who came to pay their condolences.
Joo Seol-pung said, supporting Joo Joo-hwan.
“Are you okay?”
“Are you really okay? Shouldn’t we go to the meeting place?”
“It shouldn’t be.”
“Mmm!”
“If I were to have a private conversation with the lord of the eunryeonhoe right now, the Geumcheonhoe would think that the chief had a close relationship with the eunryeonhoe. Unfortunately, we have to keep our distance.”
“You must be having a hard time.”
“no.”
“Whoa! Let’s do our best.”
“yes!”
It felt like sitting on a cushion of thorns.
It was when they sighed and tried to return to their seats.
“Sweet Lord!”
Suddenly, the commander-in-chief burst into the room in a gasp.
The hearts of the two sank, wondering if something had happened again this time.
“What is it?”
“I have come.”
“Who do you mean?”
Instead of answering, the commander-in-chief looked at the front door.
The bodies of everyone, including Joo Joo-hwan, were concentrated at the main gate.
It was strangely still.
There were so many people inside and outside the manor, but no one breathed loudly.
It was a very strange thing, but no one thought of it.
They are so focused that they don’t even feel that the air currents in the hall are forcing them to be silent.
Jang Mu-geuk and Lee Geom-han’s eyes shone especially coldly.
Of these many, only they feel and react to the anomaly.
It’s been a long time since I felt this tingling in my fingertips.
I don’t know who it is, but the person who is entering the front door now has made them nervous.
‘Who are you?’
‘Which one?’
A moment later, a black shadow appeared.
It was a figure wearing a deeply pressed hat attached to a black bloody robe.
The moment they saw him, Zhang Mu-geuk and Lee Geom-han froze at the same time.
Because I knew his identity at a glance.
‘Reaper?’
‘The moon!’
Although they couldn’t see their real faces because of the deeply worn hats, they instinctively sensed that the opponent was Pyowol.
Pyo-wol was the only man in Gangho who exuded such a unique and disparate atmosphere.
“The author…”
“Pyowol!”
Jang Ho-yeon and Namgung Seol also recognized Pyo-wol’s identity.
As soon as they noticed the leap, they got excited and tried to move.
This is because Namgungseol, not to mention Jang Hoyeon, is also wary of Pyowol.
They were the ones who thought that the Pyowol was a big hindrance to the Geumcheonhoe and Eunryeonhoe. Therefore, they thought that removing it as soon as possible was the way for them.
At that moment, if Jang Wu-geuk and Lee Geom-han had not stopped them, they would have attacked Pyo-wol right away.
Jang Moo-geuk raised his hand to block Jang Ho-yeon’s movement, and Lee Geom-han grabbed Namgung-seol’s hand to calm him down.
‘why?’
They looked at Jang Moo-geuk and Lee Geom-han with puzzled expressions. But the two just shook their heads in silence.
In the meantime, Pyowol made his way through the crowd and arrived in front of the altar where Roh Tae-tae’s ancestral tablet was hanging.
“Pyo… Daehyeop!”
The snowy wind approached, calling for the moon in a low voice.
Pyowol silently handed him a leather pouch.
“This?”
“Open it.”
At Pyo-wol’s low words, Ju-seol-wind cautiously opened the pouch. Then I saw the face of King Gu Jin, who opened his eyes wide.
“Is Lee Ji-ja King Gu Jin?”
“that’s right!”
“thank you. thank you. Your great-grandmother will rest in peace now.”
The main snow wind bowed its head to Pyowol.
His shoulder was twitching as he held the leather pouch.
People’s attention was focused on the main snow wind.
I wonder why he is so upset when his expression doesn’t change even when he is hit by giants like Jang Mu-geuk and Lee Geom-han.
On the other hand, he also wanted to know the identity of the person who gave the leather pouch to Ju Seol-pung.
Judging from the atmosphere, I got the impression that it was an unusual existence, but I couldn’t tell what its real identity was because it was covering its face with a hat.
Pyo-wol looked at Noh Tae-tae’s mortuary tablet without a word.
I still had a good look at Roh Tae-tae, but I couldn’t believe that he was no longer in this world.
After staring at the mortuary tablet for a while, Pyowol turned and headed outside. Then, Ju Seol-pung, Jang Joo-hwan, and all the blood relatives of the top of the Jewon took a fist at his back. And Joo Ji-hwan spoke on behalf of everyone.
“Thank you very much for your help. We, Jewon Sangdan, will never forget your grace. If you call, all the family members of the Jewon Sangdan will run to the ends of hell.”
In the end, Joo Ji-hwan did not mention the name of Pyo-wol.
In my heart, I wanted to reveal that Pyo-wol was a benefactor, but I knew that Pyo-wol was not what I wanted.
Unlike other people, Pyowol was reluctant to publicize his name.
This time, it was for Roh Tae-tae, not for fame.
Knowing Pyo-wol’s heart, Joo Ji-hwan and Ju Seol-pung only called Pyo-wol’s name in their hearts.
In the midst of everyone’s attention, Pyowol escaped from the top of the jewon.
After he disappeared, Ju Seol-pung took a leather pouch and went to the platform where Roh Tae-tae’s mortuary tablet hung.
After looking at the mortuary tablet for a while, Ju Seol-pung immediately took out an object from his pocket and put it on the table.
“what?”
“It’s the head of a man.”
“what?”
The people who came to condolences were astonished.
He didn’t know that the object in the leather pouch was a human head.
To place a dead man’s head on a dead man’s mortuary tablet.
People couldn’t say anything.
then someone said
“It’s King Gujin. King Gujin’s head is clear.”
“A king? oh my god!”
“If so, did he bring the head of King Gujin who killed Roh Tae-tae?”
“Nonsense!”
People realized what had happened and started talking.
Joo Joo-hwan and the blood relatives of the Jewon Headquarters all knelt down in front of the altar and said.
“I avenged my mother. Rest in peace now.”
“Rest in peace.”
“Huh!”
It was only then that the blood relatives of the Jewon Top shed the tears they had been holding back.
Their tears softened the atmosphere in the hall.
Everyone’s eyes were focused on the supply and demand of the unit and blood relatives of the Jewon Sangdan. Because of that, they did not know that Mu-geuk Jang and Geom-han Lee had quietly left the place.

chapters.title: Chapter 565
chapters.content:
Episode 565
“Brother!”
When Pyo-wol left the jewon top, Soma greeted him with a smile.
“let’s go!”
“huh!”
The two walked the streets shoulder to shoulder.
Except for the top of the memorial, which was crowded with mourners, the night streets were generally quiet.
“Hi-Hi!”
Soma burst into laughter.
It was because it felt good to meet Pyowol after a long time. But his laugh soon faded.
It was because of those who silently blocked their way.
Ten warriors who radiate unusual momentum.
They blocked the path of Pyowol and Soma.
As Pyowol looked at him in silence, one of them stepped forward.
“Someone wants to see you.”
“…”
“I don’t want to cause trouble. So please follow me quietly.”
The man’s voice was very low. So, it made the listener feel psychological pressure.
Not only was his voice low-pitched, but the implicit radiance from his body was also amazing.
The momentum was so strong that it felt like an iron wall was standing in front of my eyes.
It was because the opponents were Pyowol and Soma, but if it was someone else, I wouldn’t have been able to straighten my hamstrings at the momentum he radiated.
Pyowol asked the man.
“Your name?”
“You won’t even hear it. Because I hardly ever worked in Gangho.”
“I still want to hear it.”
“This is Lee Ki-myeong.”
“Did you come out of Cheonmujang?”
“Related, but not from Cheonmujang.”
“It looks like it was raised to protect Zhang Wu-geuk.”
“…”
Lee Gi-myeong remained silent.
His silence soon became the answer.
Cheonmujang had tremendous power like Yi Kang in the world. However, such enormous power could not be moved easily.
This is because another superpower called Gwangmumun is holding them in check.
When Cheonmujang moves, Gwangmumun also moves in response.
It was impossible to move large-scale troops unless they saw a match.
It was the same with Gwangmumun.
Their every move was being watched by the Cheonmujang. Because of this, I couldn’t send all my power to the river.
Cheonmujang set up several camouflage gates to avoid Gwangmumun’s surveillance.
After dispatching the core personnel of Cheonmujang, he raised the camouflage faction by providing funds.
Lee Gi-myung was one of the warriors raised in the Camouflage Moonpa.
Early on, his talent was recognized, and he was taught excellent magic and jeolhak. As a result, he was able to achieve achievement comparable to the brilliant talents in Cheonmujang.
Because of that, I was very proud of myself.
he asked.
“What are you going to do? I want you to follow me obediently.”
“If you refuse, are you saying you’re going to subdue at least by force?”
“I hope that doesn’t happen.”
It was expressed euphemistically, but it meant that he would use force if necessary.
Pyo-wol looked into Lee Ki-myung’s eyes for a moment and then nodded.
“good! Follow me.”
“Good idea. I will take you to the place where the lord is.”
He led the way, and Pyowol and Soma followed. And again, Lee Ki-myeong’s subordinates surrounded them in a circle and moved on.
Despite being surrounded by Ki Myung Lee and his subordinates, Soma did not look frightened at all.
Instead, he smiled and whispered to Pyowol.
“Why are these brothers so angry?”
“It seems that you don’t know because you are in the non-partisan faction. Most of the unmanned people in Gangho these days are like that.”
“You must be tired. Tsk tsk!”
Soma clicked his tongue and shook his head.
Seeing Soma like that, the warriors who followed him made a tearful expression without realizing it. But they bit their lips and suppressed their emotions.
The place where Lee Ki-myeong arrived was a small pavilion by Poyang Lake.
Jang Mu-geuk and Jang Ho-yeon were standing in the pavilion.
Zhang Mu-geuk said to Pyo-wol.
“Come on. Long time no see.”
“Right.”
Pyowol replied as he took off the hat he was wearing.
Zhang Wujie said with a slight frown on his face, shining white in the moonlight.
“That face is still the same.”
“So are you.”
“Why did you kill King Gu Jin?”
“Should I even tell you why?”
“I’m just curious personally. It caught my curiosity about what kind of relationship it had with the Jewon Corps.”
“I don’t see any reason why I should tell you the personal story.”
“hmm!”
Zhang Wujiu rubbed his chin with his hand.
After meeting in Jinga, I met Pyowol after a long time.
Pyowol then and now Pyowol were completely different people.
Even then, Pyo-wol, like now, completely hid his presence. But I couldn’t fool Zhang Wu-geuk’s eyes.
They said they were hiding everything, but it was because a sharp presence like a dagger broke through. But now it was different.
It was right in front of my eyes, but I didn’t feel any presence.
It felt like a ghost was standing there.
It was a different level of martial arts compared to when we met in Jinga.
The fact that this level of development could be achieved in a short period of time was enough to make Pyowol a dangerous existence.
At that time, Wujing Zhang thought that he should remove the symbol.
It is not only unimaginable that a person with the same temperament, eyesight, and talent as Pyowol would be under another person, and even if he were placed under someone else, he thought that complete control would be impossible.
‘Tsk! If it wasn’t for Dokgohwang’s friend…’
Dokgohwang tried to make Pyowol his subordinate.
Because of this, Zhang Wu-geuk could not move in earnest.
Looking at the appearance of Woo Il-shin (又日新), I regretted the decision at the time.
Pyowol then asked.
“What did you ask to see?”
“Make a suggestion.”
“If you ask me to join the Golden Heaven, I will refuse.”
“why? It won’t hurt you.”
“What are you going to do with Dokgo Hwang? Do you think he will tolerate the death of his woman by my hand?”
“If you give me time, I can convince you enough. Because he is a friend who can put aside his personal feelings in front of a cause.”
“Are human emotions so easily controlled?”
“What else can I do? Aren’t you living like that too? It all depends on your mindset. Isn’t it that difficult, especially for those of us who can control our emotions well?”
“I refuse.”
“There is no room for rethinking.”
“You didn’t even expect me to accept it in the first place, did you?”
At Pyo-wol’s words, Zhang Wu-geuk shook his head slightly.
“The vitriol remains.”
“Because there must be things that don’t change.”
“Ask me one more time. What is your relationship with the Jewon Sangdan?”
“I know you’ve already answered, so why are you asking that again?”
“Because I have to react differently depending on your answer.”
“It looks like the top of the jewon is burdened?”
“A person who has built a mountain of wealth is always a burden to those in power. Especially in times of chaos like now.”
The enormous financial power of the Jewon Group was a great threat to the Geumcheonhoe.
It was unpredictable what kind of synergistic effect would result if a group with such enormous wealth joined forces with an assassin named Pyowol.
That was the reason Zhang Wu-geuk was concerned about the combination of the Pyo-wol and the top of the Ji-won.
Pyowol said.
“I had a personal relationship with Roh Tae-tae.”
“You mean personal?”
“okay!”
“Can you prove it?”
“no! I don’t even know why it should be.”
“I’ve always thought about it, but you don’t seem to be afraid, do you?”
“No, I am very scared.”
“is it? Unexpected.”
“So, knock on the stone bridge and cross it. Otherwise, I would not have survived until now.”
“You wise friend. I hope you continue to make such wise choices in the future.”
“It’s none of your business what I choose.”
“yes. You’d better listen to me, though. Even for you and the people involved…”
Zhang Wujie’s tone was very plain. But even the contents inside were not ordinary.
Pyo-wol could feel all the hidden intentions and murderous intentions in his words.
Goosebumps appeared on the skin.
Few people gave him this feeling. And they were all the best masters in Gangho.
Zhang Wu-geuk had already been on the same rank as them a long time ago. The exact extent of his achievements now could only be known by competing directly.
Pyowol replied without a change in expression.
“Remember.”
It was at this time that Zhang Mu-geuk slightly frowned at his plain answer.
“Is that sword fear?”
I heard Jang Ho-yeon’s voice.
His gaze was fixed on the longsword hanging from Soma’s waist.
Soma replied cheerfully.
“huh! That’s right bro! It was taken away by the great grandpa, but I got it back this time.”
“Hand over your fears to me. Then, I’ll pretend that the Eunwon until now didn’t exist.”
Jang Ho-yeon held out her hand to Soma.
After all, it all started because of the fear at the hands of Soma.
Jang Pyeong-san, his father and the owner of the ox sword lodge, had a hobby of collecting famous swords.
His half-brother, Jang Moo-yeon, lost his life trying to steal the fear in order to satisfy his desire, which is inexhaustible at the sight of a famous sword.
In order to retrieve the revenge and fear of Zhang Mu-yeon, Jang Ho-yeon came out to Gangho, and somehow he was connected to Zhang Wu-geuk and joined the Golden Circle.
Ironically, all of this happened because of that one sword. So, I had to get my hands on it.
“Give me fear.”
“Nope.”
His face contorted at Soma’s words.
“What did you just say?”
“I said no. Fear is mine.”
“You don’t know the seriousness of the matter. If you just hand that sword over to me, you will be at ease. It means that you can live comfortably without being swept away by Kang Ho’s favor. Don’t you know?”
“know! I still hate it.”
“profit!”
It was when Jang Mu-yeon’s face turned into a yaksha.
“How much would the powerful people laugh at if they knew that the owner of the ox sword lodge was trying to steal a sword from a child?”
Suddenly, a sonorous voice was heard.
Jang Moo-geuk and Jang Ho-yeon’s eyes turned to the direction where the voice came from.
A man and a woman were walking towards the place where their eyes were directed.
“This…black man!”
“Namgungseol!”
They were Lee Geom-han and Namgung-seol, who came to the top of the memorial service.
When they appeared, Jang Ho-yeon quickly calmed down.
Zhang Muji looked at them and opened his mouth.
“You guys are here too.”
“If this person sides with you, this side will also be in trouble in many ways.”
Lee Geom-han replied calmly.
“The sword of the world is over. Are you only moving because of one assassin?”
“Isn’t that the same for you? Please, let’s not hide our true feelings. What kind of ugliness is this when everyone knows each other?”
“Cheer up.”
“Let’s fight fair and square. Aren’t the Golden Reunion and Union Reunion enough?”
“You are confident.”
“I can always be proud in front of you.”
Lee Geom-han looked at Jang Moo-geuk with his hands behind his back.
His awe-inspiring appearance touched Zhang Mu-geuk’s nerves. However, Zhang Wu-geuk did not show any rudeness by hasty seizures or raising his voice.
Lee Geom-han was his adversary sent from heaven.
I couldn’t look ugly in front of him.
Zhang Wujie smiled coldly.
“I’m looking forward to seeing if that confidence will be maintained even after the Union Association collapses.”
“That won’t happen.”
A spark seemed to fly between the two of them.
With every word spoken, the air around them stirred.
Not only Jang Ho-yeon but also Namgung Seol could not relax in the fight between the two.
Pyowol looked at the two of them alternately before opening his mouth.
“Somehow this doesn’t seem like a place for me to be. I’ll go first.”
“Pay attention to my words!”
“This guy doesn’t care too much.”
Jang Mu-geuk and Lee Geom-han each said a word.
Pyowol stepped back with Soma.
Jang Ho-yeon and Namgung-seol made sad faces.
‘I have to take away the fear.’
‘Should I miss this golden opportunity to get rid of the author?’
I didn’t know when another opportunity like this would come if I sent Pyowol now.
